IMG_2285.HEIC.title: Beach: resort and restaurant frontage
IMG_2285.HEIC.observation: View from the pebble-strewn beach toward the white resort and beach restaurant frontage, with palms and seaward terraces. Useful for broad building silhouettes and the sand/stone mix; no restaurant footprint or beach elevation is measured here.

IMG_2286.HEIC.title: Elena junction: side-by-side ramp and steps
IMG_2286.HEIC.observation: Close view of a terracotta approach with a smooth sloping strip beside a flight of shallow steps, low white edging, and a transverse drain at the foot. Clipped hedge, blue flowers and a partially visible Elena plaque identify the junction. The separate steps are visible evidence not yet matched to detailed game geometry.

IMG_2287.HEIC.title: Elena junction: private doorway and planting
IMG_2287.HEIC.observation: A private brown timber door sits above small tiled entrance steps behind a low white planting wall. Blue flowers and bougainvillea screen white plaster fronts; a tall black lantern and flush utility cover are visible. Private door steps are distinct from the shared junction ramp.

IMG_2288.HEIC.title: Cervantes area: passage signed Calle Miguel
IMG_2288.HEIC.observation: Inside a covered walk-through with a visible CALLE MIGUEL plaque. Red square tiles with small decorative inserts, black hanging lanterns, barred windows, potted plants and an arch opening onto a narrow planted lane are visible. The plaque is observed; association with the full mapped Miguel de Cervantes name needs review.

IMG_2289.HEIC.title: Cervantes exit: white-edged tiled approach
IMG_2289.HEIC.observation: Looking toward the roadside hedge over a terracotta approach bounded by low white walls and planting. A drain crosses the lower end and a black lantern stands at the corner. The shape and planting support the entrance reference; the image alone does not measure its rise.

IMG_2290.HEIC.title: Pintor Dalí: grass between bays and shared footpath
IMG_2290.HEIC.observation: A parked car and white bay markings sit beside a grass strip with broad-leaved planting. A separate terracotta house-side footpath and white plaster frontages are behind the grass. Confirms the surface order; widths remain estimated.

IMG_2291.HEIC.title: Pintor Dalí: arched entrance and white facade
IMG_2291.HEIC.observation: Frontal view of a two-storey white building with an arched ground-level opening, rounded plaster balcony edge, timber shutters, barred window and lantern. The terracotta house-side footpath runs between the facade and a narrow lawn/parking edge.

IMG_2292.HEIC.title: Pintor Dalí: continuous tiled footpath and lawns
IMG_2292.HEIC.observation: Oblique view along white two-storey frontages, the shared terracotta path, narrow grass strip and asphalt bays. Arched openings, black window grilles, small balconies and planting divide the frontage. Useful for proportions and surface continuity.

IMG_2293.HEIC.title: Pintor Dalí: lane entrance, ramp and drain
IMG_2293.HEIC.observation: A terracotta entrance slopes from the parking area into a narrow lane between white patio walls and dense planting. A green drain/service grate is at the foot and a tall traditional black lantern stands at the corner. Lane name is not visible; do not assume this is Cervantes.

IMG_2294.HEIC.title: Dalí seaward end: flagstone approach to arch
IMG_2294.HEIC.observation: Pale irregular flagstone paving leads through an arched covered passage. Flared low white curbs, clipped hedges, blue flowers and climbing plants frame the approach. Stone paving is distinct from the square-tiled entrances elsewhere.

IMG_2295.HEIC.title: Dalí seaward end: covered access and shutters
IMG_2295.HEIC.observation: Second view of the flagstone approach and arched passage, showing the tiled canopy, dark louvred shutters, side balcony and planting. Corroborates IMG_2294; it is not independent measurement of the passage dimensions.

IMG_2296.HEIC.title: Dalí seaward end: parking turn and coast boundary
IMG_2296.HEIC.observation: View around the widened asphalt end area toward a low white wall and metal fence by the sea. Yellow curb paint, white bay lines, red-and-white post, a no-parking sign, palms and flowering planting identify the coastal turn.

IMG_2297.HEIC.title: Dalí seaward end: narrow pedestrian gate
IMG_2297.HEIC.observation: A narrow dark metal pedestrian gate sits beside a white pier, rigid metal mesh on a low white plinth to the left, and a taller solid white wall to the right. A modern slim lamp, yellow curb paint and a no-parking sign identify the asphalt parking end. The wall/mesh/gate arrangement is now represented in the structural model; plan position, gate width and wall heights remain estimates.
IMG_2297.HEIC.visualReview: Compared with structural wall/mesh/gate model; arrangement represented, plan position and dimensions remain estimates

IMG_2298.HEIC.title: Beach: white seaward houses and palm
IMG_2298.HEIC.observation: Beach-level view back toward two-storey white homes, dark shutters, a palm and the low coast boundary. Sand and scattered pebbles fill the foreground. This camera position is shared with the next two differently directed views.

IMG_2299.HEIC.title: Beach: houses along the shore
IMG_2299.HEIC.observation: Oblique beach view along the row of white seaward houses and palms, with a pebbled sandy foreground and distant coastline. Useful for the coastline-side silhouette and texture; individual house positions are not determined from this view.

IMG_2300.HEIC.title: Beach: pebbles, sand and distant coastline
IMG_2300.HEIC.observation: Wide view along the beach with mixed sand, stones and rounded pebbles, the sea to the right and low buildings beyond. Provides a stronger ground-material reference than a uniform pale-sand texture.

IMG_2360.HEIC.title: Roof by Elena: looking east-north-east along Cervantes
IMG_2360.HEIC.observation: From a roof terrace beside Calle Elena, looking roughly along the line of Cervantes. Below: courtyard walls with magenta bougainvillea, a patio with a timber pergola, arched first-floor windows, a wooden balcony under a small barrel-tile roof and iron balconies. Beyond: flat roofs with solar panels, the long apartment block, a tall palm and the sea at the right. Camera on a roof, so the pin sits inside a registry building.

IMG_2361.HEIC.title: Roof by Elena: looking down into a gated tiled entry
IMG_2361.HEIC.observation: Looking south-west down over barrel roof tiles into a narrow entry between two-storey houses: patterned terracotta floor tiles, a pair of black iron gates in a white gateway topped with bougainvillea, a small first-floor balcony and an arched opening with lantern beyond. Gives the width and enclosure of the entry from above; dimensions are not measured. Camera on the roof of the covered-passage building (registry part 6265201UF1366N_part5).

IMG_2362.HEIC.title: Roof by Elena: looking east-south-east over the terraces to the sea
IMG_2362.HEIC.observation: Over lichen-mottled barrel roof tiles and a tall magnolia-like hedge: a wooden balcony with a tiled canopy, iron balconies with arched shuttered doors, flat roofs with solar panels and chimneys, a Norfolk pine, palms, and the sea on the horizon. Good for roofscape and facade detail.

IMG_2363.HEIC.title: Roof by Elena: looking down the lane to the north pool lawn gate
IMG_2363.HEIC.observation: Looking almost straight down from a roof edge, north-north-west: a narrow square-tiled terracotta lane between white walls with a planted strip, private patios behind low walls with brown doors, and an arched white garden gateway with bougainvillea that opens onto crazy paving and the north pool lawn (bollard lights, palm, tree). Shows how the Elena north lane meets the north pool courtyard.

6E090F77-BFAF-46F8-A753-0388F6BD1DB5.jpg.title: Beach: pebbles on sand at the water line
6E090F77-BFAF-46F8-A753-0388F6BD1DB5.jpg.observation: Wide 16:9 image of the beach at the water line: coarse grey-brown sand with scattered dark rounded pebbles, a denser pebble band along the shore, small breaking waves and a kite-surfer far out. No location data in the file, so it is unplaced; which stretch of beach it shows is not confirmed.

IMG_2345.HEIC.title: Pintor Picasso: service road, utility sheds and bins
IMG_2345.HEIC.observation: Looking north-west up the asphalt service road off Calle Pintor Picasso. Left: a dark slatted fence, then low white utility sheds with brown doors and a meter box, then a long plain white boundary wall. Right: a low white building on a rough stone plinth with black tubular railings and a short concrete ramp, green and grey recycling bins, and large plane trees. Palms and the mountains beyond.

IMG_2364.HEIC.title: Roof by Elena: barrel-tile lean-to over a magnolia bed
IMG_2364.HEIC.observation: From a roof edge looking south-east: a mono-pitch roof of lichen-mottled barrel tiles drops beside a tall dense magnolia-like shrub. Beyond: a two-storey white front with arched shuttered windows, a small barrel-tile canopy over a balcony and magenta bougainvillea.

IMG_2365.HEIC.title: Roof by Elena: looking down on the Elena north lane and its planted bed
IMG_2365.HEIC.observation: Almost straight down onto Calle Elena north, looking south-south-east: a straight square-tiled terracotta lane about 1.5 m wide with a narrow white edging kerb. On its left a raised planting bed of tall magnolia-like shrubs edged with strap-leaved plants, ending in a small bed boxed by a clipped hedge. On its right white house walls, a white sill/bench and a first-floor balcony with an iron rail. The lane turns right at the far end by bougainvillea.

IMG_2332.HEIC.title: Middle pool west side: path between the deck and a raised planter wall
IMG_2332.HEIC.observation: Looking north-north-west along the middle pool. A grey-brown crazy-paving path with a drain cover runs between the cream pool deck (behind the glass fence) and a raised white planter wall about 0.8 m high topped by a dense hedge with red flowers. Beyond: a lawn inside the glass fence, a white garden wall with a brown arched-top door, a small pergola entrance, clipped hedges and two-storey white houses with bougainvillea. GPS ±14 m, so the pin alone does not fix which lobe.

IMG_2339.HEIC.title: Calle Eva: walled lawn corner with espaliered bougainvillea
IMG_2339.HEIC.observation: A small lawn in the corner of two white garden walls, with bougainvillea trained flat along both walls, a green bollard light and a clipped shrub at the front. Square terracotta tiles with a grey border run along the near edge. Useful for wall planting and the bollard light.

IMG_2340.HEIC.title: Calle Eva: east gateway into the middle pool courtyard
IMG_2340.HEIC.observation: A white gateway with square piers and a gently curved coping over a flat head, an open black iron gate, and a terracotta path with a drain leading through to the middle pool (glass fence, bird-of-paradise, hedges). A Comunidad Villacana notice and two blue dog-rule signs are on the right pier; white walls with planting run either side. Matches the gate seen from inside in IMG_2244.

IMG_2350.HEIC.title: Paseo looking north-east: stamped walk, sandstone retaining wall
IMG_2350.HEIC.observation: The seafront promenade: pink-red stamped concrete about 3 m wide with a timber edge onto a strip of sandy, stony beach. On the landward side a yellow sandstone retaining wall about 1.2 m high carries a green mesh fence, with the white seafront houses (round tower with a tiled roof, balconies) standing above it. Slim white lamp posts, palms, the Barraka restaurant and the mountains in the distance. Shows the resort ground standing above the paseo here.

IMG_2327.HEIC.title: Cervantes at Elena: steps up to a door beside the lane
IMG_2327.HEIC.observation: Looking west up Cervantes from the Elena junction. On the right two red-tread steps with white sides climb to a brown timber door between a plumbago hedge and bougainvillea; the lane beyond shows the ramp strip and the steps beside it, a drain across the foot and service covers in the tiles.

IMG_2328.HEIC.title: Cervantes at Elena: ramp and steps side by side, drain at the foot
IMG_2328.HEIC.observation: Looking west-south-west up Cervantes: the smooth ramp strip on the left, the white-edged steps on the right, one drain grate right across the lane at the foot, white kerbs and clipped hedges both sides, a door step on the far right. Confirms the split ramp/steps built from IMG_2286.

IMG_2329.HEIC.title: Cervantes/Elena junction: lawn with a pollarded tree and white kerb
IMG_2329.HEIC.observation: Looking south-south-west across the junction: a small lawn edged by a low rounded white kerb, a pollarded tree with a round head, a manhole cover in the grass, terracotta paving round it, and two-storey houses with bougainvillea and balconies behind.

IMG_2330.HEIC.title: Calle Elena south from the junction, towards the middle pool
IMG_2330.HEIC.observation: Looking south along Elena south: a straight square-tiled lane between a hedge and planting on the left and a lawn on the right, white low kerb, pollarded trees, a palm and white terraces at the far end.

IMG_2331.HEIC.title: Middle pool north: crazy-paving path opening onto the lawn and pool
IMG_2331.HEIC.observation: Crazy-paving path between a hedge and a white wall, widening into a lawn wedge, with the pool and its glass fence beyond; a black iron gate at the right edge. GPS ±17 m, so the pin is only a rough guide.

IMG_2333.HEIC.title: Middle pool south-west: stone steps up a tiled path to a gate
IMG_2333.HEIC.observation: A terracotta-tiled path with three rough stone steps climbing between a tall hedge and a raised white wall, to a white gateway with bougainvillea at the top. A change of level leaving the middle pool courtyard.

IMG_2334.HEIC.title: Middle pool south: iron gate in a pergola frame onto a lane
IMG_2334.HEIC.observation: Looking south through a black iron double gate under a curved metal pergola frame: crazy paving with a drain grate, a raised white planter with shrubs on the right with a white step, a tiled lane beyond between white walls and planting.

IMG_2335.HEIC.title: Middle pool south: raised white planter with a blue tile panel
IMG_2335.HEIC.observation: Close view of a raised white rendered planter and wall with a framed panel of blue-and-white tiles, a seat-height wall bench recessed into it with a low plinth in front, and climbers above. Detail for the courtyard walls.

IMG_2336.HEIC.title: Calle Eva east of the middle pool: tiled path between lawns
IMG_2336.HEIC.observation: Looking north-east along a square-tiled path between two lawns, with round-headed trees, black lamp posts, low hedges and white terraces beyond.

IMG_2337.HEIC.title: Calle Eva east of the middle pool: lawn, round trees, lamp
IMG_2337.HEIC.observation: Similar view looking north-north-east: a lawn with a round-headed tree, bougainvillea on a white garden wall with brown doors, a black lamp post and the tiled path at the right edge.

IMG_2338.HEIC.title: Calle Eva: brown door, yellow-flowered shrub, lawn
IMG_2338.HEIC.observation: A brown timber door with a house-number plaque, a yellow-flowered shrub (St John's wort-like) beside it, a lawn and a pink-tiled path edge.

IMG_2341.HEIC.title: Curved low white wall with hedge, crazy paving and trees
IMG_2341.HEIC.observation: A curving low white wall topped by a clipped hedge beside crazy paving, with trees, garden tables and white terraces behind. GPS ±47 m: the place is not established from the pin; probably the middle pool courtyard.

IMG_2342.HEIC.title: Cervantes/Elena junction: lawn corner with pollarded tree and drain
IMG_2342.HEIC.observation: The junction lawn from another angle: white rounded kerb, pollarded tree, manhole, terracotta paving with a drain grate in the foreground, bougainvillea on the houses. GPS ±14 m.

IMG_2346.HEIC.title: Barraka Beach sign, thatched parasols and boardwalk
IMG_2346.HEIC.observation: On Barraka Beach: white planted BARRAKA BEACH sign, sand-filled barbecue boat on the left of the timber boardwalk looking seaward, thatched parasols and loungers. The boat is distinct from the planted sign.

IMG_2347.HEIC.title: Barraka Beach sign and boardwalk to the beach
IMG_2347.HEIC.observation: On Barraka Beach: white planted BARRAKA BEACH sign, sand-filled barbecue boat on the left of the timber boardwalk looking seaward, thatched parasols and loungers. The boat is distinct from the planted sign.

IMG_2349.HEIC.title: From the paseo: sandstone retaining wall and fence below the south pool
IMG_2349.HEIC.observation: Looking north-north-west from the paseo at the yellow sandstone retaining wall with a green mesh fence on top and a clipped hedge behind; the south pool area (pool, glass fence, white terraces) stands above it.

IMG_2351.HEIC.title: Paseo looking south: stamped walk, timber edge, beach and sea
IMG_2351.HEIC.observation: Looking south from the paseo over its pink stamped concrete and timber edge to the sandy, stony beach and the sea, a kite-surfer offshore.

IMG_2352.HEIC.title: Paseo looking west: sandstone wall, mesh fence, lamp posts
IMG_2352.HEIC.observation: Looking west-south-west along the paseo: the sandstone retaining wall and green mesh fence on the right, slim white lamp posts, palms, beach scrub on the left.

IMG_2354.HEIC.title: Paseo curving north-east beside the sandstone wall
IMG_2354.HEIC.observation: The paseo curving north-east with the sandstone retaining wall and green mesh fence on the left, a service cover in the stamped surface, the timber edge on the right.

IMG_2355.HEIC.title: Cervantes/Elena steps from the junction
IMG_2355.HEIC.observation: Close view of the three steps beside the ramp: white riser faces, terracotta treads with grey edges, the white wall and hedge on the right, the drain grate across the foot. Confirms the step arrangement built from IMG_2286.

IMG_2356.HEIC.title: Cervantes east of Elena: lane beside a plumbago hedge
IMG_2356.HEIC.observation: Looking north-east along Cervantes east of the Elena junction: a square-tiled lane with a low white kerb wall, a tall plumbago and shrub hedge on the left, patches of sun through trees.

IMG_2358.HEIC.title: Roof by Elena: looking down on Elena south and the junction lawns
IMG_2358.HEIC.observation: From a roof terrace looking south-south-east: the Elena south lane, small lawns with round clipped shrubs, private patios with walls, a brown door and a lamp post. Overhead layout of the junction's south side.

IMG_2359.HEIC.title: Roof by Elena: over barrel tiles to the Cervantes patios
IMG_2359.HEIC.observation: From the roof looking south-west over a barrel-tile roof: white walls, private patios with bougainvillea and shrubs, a parasol, and the lawns along Cervantes.

IMG_2366.HEIC.title: Roof by Elena: patios east of the Elena beds
IMG_2366.HEIC.observation: Looking down east-north-east from a roof: private patios behind white walls with bougainvillea, a timber pergola, outdoor furniture, and the tops of the magnolia shrubs. The east-side patios beyond the Elena beds.

IMG_2367.HEIC.title: Roof by Elena: looking south over the Cervantes/Elena junction
IMG_2367.HEIC.observation: From the roof looking south: the junction lawns with round shrubs and the Elena south lane, patio walls with bougainvillea and parasols in the foreground.

IMG_2368.HEIC.title: Roof by Elena: patios and terraces south-west, along Cervantes
IMG_2368.HEIC.observation: Looking south-west from the roof over walled patios with trees, parasols and bougainvillea to the two-storey terraces along Cervantes and the tall trees on Dalí.

IMG_2369.HEIC.title: Roof by Elena: patios and terraces south-west (second shot)
IMG_2369.HEIC.observation: Same view as IMG_2368, slightly to the left.

IMG_2481.HEIC.title: Paseo looking north-east towards Barraka: curving pink walk, sandstone wall, dry verge
IMG_2481.HEIC.observation: From the paseo's west stretch (52 mm lens): pink stamped walk curving between the sandstone retaining wall with green mesh fence and slim white lamps on the left, and a broad dry earth verge with a timber edge on the right. Barraka beach restaurant, its white pergola and thatched parasols ahead; La Concha behind. Phone GPS +/-2 m.

IMG_2482.HEIC.title: Paseo looking north-east: agave verge and Barraka restaurant
IMG_2482.HEIC.observation: Pink stamped walk with its timber edge, a row of young agaves planted along the verge, sandstone wall and fence on the left with slim white lamps at its foot; Barraka (two-storey white building with maroon awnings), white timber pergola and parasols at the far end. 52 mm lens.

IMG_2483.HEIC.title: Paseo looking north-east, second shot: agave verge to Barraka
IMG_2483.HEIC.observation: Same view as IMG_2482 turned a little right: agave row along the timber edge, open dry verge, Barraka restaurant, pergola, palms and parasols. 52 mm lens.

IMG_2488.HEIC.title: Calle Guillermo from its seaward end, looking up the lane
IMG_2488.HEIC.observation: Square terracotta-tiled lane between a whitewashed house wall (left, wide base plinth, meter box) and a raised white planter with strelitzia and lantana (right). A slot drain crosses the lane about 4 m ahead; lawns, a green lantern post and white garden walls beyond, a blue awning on a curved-topped wall at the far right. No steps visible. Phone GPS +/-4.7 m.

IMG_2494.HEIC.title: Narrow lane by Teodoro Rojo: barred windows, planter, drains
IMG_2494.HEIC.observation: Narrow square-tiled lane between white houses: green iron window grilles, a raised white planter and a trained bougainvillea trunk on the left, an arched window recess on the right, several slot and square drain covers; bougainvillea and a tiled-roof house at the far end. Very close to IMG_2241.

IMG_2507.HEIC.title: Elena 25 passage: street arch with potted schefflera
IMG_2507.HEIC.observation: Arched opening in a white wall off Calle Elena south: plain square lane tiles with a grey margin outside, then a covered entry floored with diagonal terracotta tiles and small blue-and-white inset tiles, flush with the lane (no step). A potted schefflera inside; the entry turns right to a door. Part of the CALLE ELENA 25 passage in IMG_2508.

IMG_2508.HEIC.title: Covered passage signed CALLE ELENA 25, looking through to a garden gate
IMG_2508.HEIC.observation: Covered walk-through with a flat white ceiling and hanging lantern, brown panelled double doors on both sides, tile plaque CALLE ELENA 25, potted scheffleras and dracaena; an arch at the far end opens onto a red-tiled path and a white-framed iron garden gate under bougainvillea. Enters the registry block 6265601UF1366N_part1 east of Calle Elena south; not in data/passages.json.

IMG_2518.HEIC.title: Elena covered walkway east portal: CALLE ELENA 18 36 plaque, two steps and ramp
IMG_2518.HEIC.observation: Inside the Calle Elena covered walkway at its east end: tile plaque CALLE ELENA 18 36 (IMG_2254 shows the same plaque cropped as 18 3..), CASA WILKES and GEE name tiles beside dark brown panelled double doors, an AGUA POTABLE hatch. The passage floor is two steps (white-nosed terracotta treads) above the Calle Elena lane, with a red ribbed rubber ramp beside them.

IMG_2519.HEIC.title: Elena covered walkway looking west to the arch and the 36/34 gates
IMG_2519.HEIC.observation: From the top of the east steps: terracotta floor with blue-and-white inset tiles, red ribbed ramp on the right, a pebble mat, brown doors on both sides, then the far arch with two large potted plants and the private gates beyond (as IMG_2202).

IMG_2539.HEIC.title: Elena north by the Cervantes junction: steps and tiled lane between planted beds
IMG_2539.HEIC.observation: Ground shot looking south-west along Calle Elena north towards the Cervantes junction: square terracotta tiles with a slot drain and two inspection covers, low white bed walls with clipped shrubs and plumbago, a short flight of tiled steps up on the left beside a lawn, brown door in a white gateway with bougainvillea on the right, a street-name tile on a garden wall ahead. GPS ±16 m.

IMG_2549.HEIC.title: Calle Eva: lane between a white wall and planted beds, towards the middle pool
IMG_2549.HEIC.observation: Looking west along Calle Eva: square terracotta tiles with grey margins, a white wall with plinth on the left (tile sign), a loquat tree and planted bed on the right with a green iron fence behind, a person walking, the open area beyond.

IMG_2559.HEIC.title: Calle Patricia from its west end, looking along the lane
IMG_2559.HEIC.observation: Long straight lane of square terracotta tiles with grey margins between white garden walls; trained bougainvillea on the left wall, hedges and a candelabra cactus over the right wall, a tall pine at the far end. Answers photo request patricia-west.

IMG_2572.HEIC.title: Path between oleanders off Calle Silvia south
IMG_2572.HEIC.observation: Narrow tiled path (square terracotta, grey margin) between oleander hedges, green windbreak cloth on a fence on the left, lawns, a clipped topiary tree and white houses beyond.

IMG_2586.HEIC.title: Courtyard with arch and patterned floor near Calle Jorge
IMG_2586.HEIC.observation: Small courtyard between white houses: terracotta floor with blue-and-white inset tiles, potted palms and plants, wall lantern, iron balcony and window grilles, an arched opening at the far end under a tiled roof.

IMG_2600.HEIC.title: From the foot of Calle Guillermo: tiled path down past the white wall towards the beach
IMG_2600.HEIC.observation: Tiled ramp path descending east-south-east from beside the kiosk: lavender and shrubs on the left, a white wall with green rigid mesh on top on the right; at the bottom grass, a hedge and a green rigid-mesh fence, with the beach, parasols and shrubs beyond. A tall white pier at the left edge may be the beach gateway. The fence ahead is green rigid mesh, not the white railings the model has from IMG_2226.

IMG_2616.HEIC.title: Barraka boardwalk and BARRAKA BEACH sign planter
IMG_2616.HEIC.observation: The weathered green plank boardwalk across the sand towards the parasols, the white BARRAKA BEACH planter on the left with a thatched shade and a boat planter, terracotta pots and a strelitzia on the right.

IMG_2629.HEIC.title: Beach east of Barraka from the paseo edge
IMG_2629.HEIC.observation: Sand with a few tufts beside the pink paseo and its timber edge, Barraka's beach bar, parasols and loungers, palms and the white Barraka building on the right.

IMG_2645.HEIC.title: South pool lawn and houses
IMG_2645.HEIC.observation: Broad lawn in front of white two-storey houses with tiled roofs, arched entrance and balconies; a low white curved bed wall, steps to a terrace, and the glass pool fence on the right.

IMG_2658.HEIC.title: Covered entrance off Calle Silvia south: three tiled steps beside a red ribbed ramp
IMG_2658.HEIC.observation: Looking into a covered entrance from the lane: three steps of terracotta tiles with dark border strips and white risers, and a red ribbed rubber ramp beside them on the left, rising to a floor of terracotta with blue-and-white insets.

IMG_2675.HEIC.title: Lane off Teodoro Rojo between planted walls
IMG_2675.HEIC.observation: Tiled lane with drains between white walls, bougainvillea and a gnarled tree, hedge over a white bed wall and lawn on the right, houses at the far end.

IMG_2687.HEIC.title: Elena north: lane beside a house with window grilles, towards the lawns
IMG_2687.HEIC.observation: Square-tiled lane along a white house with green iron window grilles and a lantern, a planted bed on the right, a white gateway with a barred window and the lawns beyond.

253A75E4-A471-4502-9F5D-C9BAF074D664.jpg.title: Beach loungers and closed parasols on dark sand with timber boardwalk strips
253A75E4-A471-4502-9F5D-C9BAF074D664.jpg.observation: Looking out to sea over dark grey sand strewn with dry leaves: sun loungers with cream cushions beside furled cream parasols, and narrow timber boardwalk strips laid across the sand. No location data in the file, so it is unplaced.

IMG_2442.jpg.title: Cervantes east end: lane with candelabra cacti, white seat pillar and brick-edged steps
IMG_2442.jpg.observation: Looking WSW down a straight lane paved in terracotta octagon tiles with small square infills. A white rendered pillar with a ceramic tile plaque and a built-in seat stands on the right beside a brick-edged step and a clipped hedge, with tall candelabra cacti (euphorbia) behind it. Low white hedge-topped walls and white houses with a tiled pent roof line the left.

IMG_2443.jpg.title: Cervantes east end: same view, a few metres on
IMG_2443.jpg.observation: Near-duplicate of IMG_2442 taken a few metres further along the lane: octagon terracotta paving, white pillar with tile plaque and seat, brick-edged steps and kerb, clipped hedges and tall euphorbia cacti, a white house with pointed chimney and tiled roof on the left.

IMG_2444.jpg.title: Cervantes east end: looking back east along the lane to the car park side
IMG_2444.jpg.observation: Looking ENE along the lane: terracotta octagon paving, a white house wall on the right with an arched barred window, a white downpipe, a flat roof with a chimney and a tiled eave. On the left a clipped hedge on a white wall, pollarded trees and a lamp post, then a lawn and parked cars in the distance. A tall hotel block shows at the far left edge.

IMG_2445.jpg.title: Octagonal terracotta paving close-up on Cervantes
IMG_2445.jpg.observation: Looking down at the lane floor: large terracotta octagons with small square diamond infills set in grey grout, between white-rendered walls with a grey damp stain at the foot of the left wall. A small drain or cover is at the lower left.

IMG_2446.jpg.title: Cervantes north lawn with white two-storey house, balcony and arched garden gate
IMG_2446.jpg.observation: Looking west across a lawn edged by a white curb wall to a white two-storey house with brown shuttered openings, a wrought-iron balcony, a tiled lean-to roof and a white garden wall with a brown arched door covered in bougainvillea. A lamp post and a pollarded tree stand beside the octagon-paved path on the left; a small no-entry style sign is on the wall.

IMG_2447.jpg.title: Private patio behind the Cervantes lawn: banana plants and citrus tree
IMG_2447.jpg.observation: Looking NNW across a shaded lawn to a terracotta-paved private patio with banana plants, a large citrus-type tree, patio furniture, pots, and a white house with a glazed door and chimney. A white boundary wall runs down the right side. The foreground is in deep shadow.

IMG_2448.jpg.title: Cervantes/Alberto junction: signed wall and paving change, path with three white steps ahead
IMG_2448.jpg.observation: Looking WSW at a paving junction: large square terracotta tiles with grey stone edging in the foreground over octagon tiles, two iron manhole covers, and a narrow tiled path ahead between white walls and clipped hedges with three white-nosed steps. A black sign on the upper-left wall reads '...BERTO' (Calle Alberto).

IMG_2449.jpg.title: Cervantes lane west of Alberto: 'CALLE DE MIGUEL' wall plaque and receding tiled lane
IMG_2449.jpg.observation: Looking WSW along a narrow lane of square terracotta tiles with grey grout. A tall white wall on the left carries black lettering 'CALLE DE MIGUEL' (read as it appears) with climbers and a low succulent hedge; white pilasters and pink bougainvillea line the right; white steps with grey stone nosing rise at the lower right.

IMG_2450.jpg.title: Cervantes lane: arched covered porch on the north side, bougainvillea wall opposite
IMG_2450.jpg.observation: Looking WSW along the lane. A white wall hung with bougainvillea and climbers runs on the left; on the right a tall white rounded arch springs from a stout pier with a lantern, a barred window and a potted plant, with a drain grate and cast-iron cover in the tiled floor.

IMG_2451.jpg.title: Cervantes north side: covered 'Calle Miguel' passage with azulejo-inset floor and far arch
IMG_2451.jpg.observation: Looking NNW into a covered passage with a flat white ceiling, a hanging lantern, brown double doors on the right and left and a rounded arch at the far end showing a white gate and plants. Terracotta floor with blue-and-white decorative inset tiles in herringbone, a coir mat, a large potted ficus; black number plates on the right wall read 'CALLE MIGUEL 10 ...'.

IMG_2452.jpg.title: Cervantes north side: covered Calle Miguel passage, second view
IMG_2452.jpg.observation: Same passage as IMG_2451 from a slightly different angle: flat ceiling, pendant lantern, brown panelled door on the right in a recess, a mat, a far arch with a white gate and bougainvillea, 'CALLE MIGUEL' plate on the right wall, terracotta floor with blue-and-white inset tiles and a sunlit patch.

IMG_2453.jpg.title: Cervantes west of the passage: lane with barred shuttered window and lantana beds
IMG_2453.jpg.observation: Looking WSW along the lane. A white house wall on the right has a hooded window with green iron bars and brown louvre shutters above a bed of orange and yellow lantana; bougainvillea climbs the wall. Square terracotta tiles run ahead to a small flight of steps at the far end; a hedge and white wall are on the left.

IMG_2454.jpg.title: Cervantes east of Elena: tiled lane with white-kerbed hedge bed on the north side
IMG_2454.jpg.observation: Looking WSW down a wide lane of large square terracotta tiles. A clipped hedge on a sloping white concrete kerb runs along the right (north) side with a pebble-concrete strip, and climbers on a white wall run along the left; the lane recedes straight to the Elena junction.

IMG_2455.jpg.title: Cervantes at Elena: raised white bed with palms, 'CALLE DE ELENA' sign and brown door
IMG_2455.jpg.observation: Looking WSW towards the Elena junction. A low white-rendered raised bed with fan palms and hedge sits on the right, with a wall behind carrying a black plaque 'CALLE DE ELENA' beneath a brown door and cascading bougainvillea; a lamp bracket is on the wall. Lantana in flower in the foreground, a hedge bed edged by a low white kerb on the left, tiled lane ahead with steps in the far distance.

IMG_2456.jpg.title: Calle Elena covered walkway: looking out through an arch to a courtyard with magnolia
IMG_2456.jpg.observation: From inside a covered arched walkway looking NE through a rounded arch to a small courtyard with a pollarded magnolia, a clipped hedge, a white garden wall with a gate and bougainvillea. Floor is terracotta with blue-and-white decorative inset tiles and a dark rubber mat; a black plate on the left wall reads '...LE ELENA 18 36'.

IMG_2457.jpg.title: Pebble mosaic panel in the terracotta floor of the Elena walkway
IMG_2457.jpg.observation: Looking down at a square panel of upright black and white river pebbles laid in a radiating star pattern with a border, set into a terracotta floor with blue-and-white azulejo insert tiles. The photographer's shoes are at the bottom.

IMG_2458.jpg.title: Courtyard garden bed with magnolia and arched brown door beside the Elena walkway
IMG_2458.jpg.observation: Looking ENE from a covered passage mouth at a sunlit raised bed with a pollarded magnolia, small shrubs and a low clipped hedge in front, backed by a white garden wall with climbers and an arched brown door; a barred window with shutters is at the left and a two-storey white house with balcony behind. Terracotta paving and a white kerb edge the bed.

IMG_2459.jpg.title: Elena covered walkway: three white steps beside a red studded ramp, azulejo floor, far arch
IMG_2459.jpg.observation: Looking WSW into a covered walkway: three white-nosed steps on the left of a red studded rubber ramp, terracotta floor with blue-and-white inset tiles, brown double doors on both sides, a coir mat, large potted plants and a far arch with a white gate. A small sign is on the left wall.

IMG_2460.jpg.title: Elena north garden path: tiled path, hedge bed and magnolia, two-storey white house beyond
IMG_2460.jpg.observation: Looking SE along a terracotta-tiled path with grey edging. A clipped low hedge and bed with agapanthus-type plants and a pollarded magnolia are on the left; on the right a white curved low wall with shrubs and a black iron railing on a raised patio. A white two-storey house with arched shuttered windows, balcony and tiled roof stands beyond.

IMG_2461.jpg.title: Window grille detail: twisted iron bars and louvre shutters with red tile sill
IMG_2461.jpg.observation: Close view of a barred window with vertical twisted iron bars with oval rings, brown louvre shutters, a red-tile sill and a white rendered wall; a bougainvillea trunk and succulent shrubs grow in front.

IMG_2462.jpg.title: Bougainvillea over a white wall above a plumbago and clipped hedge, Elena junction
IMG_2462.jpg.observation: A mass of magenta bougainvillea trained against a white wall, over a mixed plumbago (blue flowers) and clipped green hedge. A white curved kerb is at the bottom left.

IMG_2463.jpg.title: Cervantes at Elena from the east: garden door, hedge bed and the three steps
IMG_2463.jpg.observation: Looking west along the lane. A white wall with curved coping and a brown door in a pilaster frame, covered in bougainvillea, stands behind a plumbago and clipped hedge on a white curved kerb on the right. Ahead is a drain strip and a short flight of grey-nosed steps with a ramp and lawn beside them.

IMG_2464.jpg.title: Elena junction on Cervantes: three steps beside the ramp, drain and 'ELENA' plaque
IMG_2464.jpg.observation: Looking WSW along the lane. A lawn with a low white kerb and a small tree is on the left with a lamp post; ahead a drain grating crosses the lane, then three white-sided steps on the right half and a smooth ramp on the left. White curved wall, oleander and plumbago, brown door at right; a plaque 'ELENA' is on a white wall beyond the left lawn.

IMG_2465.jpg.title: Junction lawn corner: white kerb, pollarded tree, manhole and house with balcony
IMG_2465.jpg.observation: Looking SSW at the corner of a lawn edged by a rounded white concrete kerb, with a pollarded round-headed tree, a round manhole cover in the grass, and a drain grating in the lane at the lower right. A white two-storey house with a tiled pent roof, a balcony with railings, brown shuttered doors and pink bougainvillea stands behind.

IMG_2466.jpg.title: Elena south footpath beside the junction lawn: kerb, lawn and three clipped trees
IMG_2466.jpg.observation: Looking south along a tiled footpath with a white round-topped kerb on the right bordering a lawn. A pollarded tree is in the foreground, two clipped globe trees and one more beyond; a white house with arched windows, bougainvillea and a palm are on the far side.

IMG_2467.jpg.title: Cervantes west of Elena: lane with brown door, grilles and oleander hedge
IMG_2467.jpg.observation: Looking WSW along the tiled lane. White house walls on the left carry a brown door, green-barred windows with shutters and a lamp bracket; on the right a tall oleander hedge, bougainvillea and a banana plant. A transverse paving joint crosses the foreground.

IMG_2468.jpg.title: Cervantes west end: arcaded porch on the left, dracaena and shrub bed on the right
IMG_2468.jpg.observation: Looking WSW towards Pintor Dali. A white arched porch with a lantern, barred window and potted plants is on the left, with azulejo-inset tiles inside; a bed of dracaena and green shrubs and a white wall are on the right; the tiled lane has two iron manhole covers in the foreground and opens to daylight at the far end.

IMG_2469.jpg.title: Cervantes west end: inside the arch, 'CALLE MIGUEL 1 19' plaque, azulejo floor and planters
IMG_2469.jpg.observation: Standing in a covered porch looking SSW: a white wall with black plaque 'CALLE MIGUEL 1 19', a brown door set at left, a potted palm and schefflera in planters, and a terracotta floor with blue-and-white inset tiles. The arch edge is on the right.

IMG_2470.jpg.title: Covered tiled portal with arch to a planted lane
IMG_2470.jpg.observation: A vaulted covered passage with a terracotta tile floor with sparse blue/white inset tiles, a doormat, a hanging lantern, dark panelled double doors on both sides and a barred window. A round arch at the far end opens onto a sunlit tiled lane with a wooden bench and clipped shrubs.

IMG_2471.jpg.title: Dalí footpath ramp with white mailbox pillar
IMG_2471.jpg.observation: A terracotta-paved footpath ramps up toward the Pintor Dalí road with a low white curb wall and kerb on the left, and a white curved-top pillar with a mail slot and bin pictogram on the right. A slot drain crosses the ramp near the bottom; a hedge and a street lamp post stand across the road.

IMG_2472.jpg.title: Tiled footpath beside Dalí car park lawn
IMG_2472.jpg.observation: A straight terracotta-tiled footpath runs north with a white rendered curb wall on its left separating a lawn strip and parked cars, and a tall white building face with bougainvillea and a planted bed on the right.

IMG_2473.jpg.title: Dalí footpath, strelitzia lawn strip and parked cars
IMG_2473.jpg.observation: The terracotta footpath runs between a white wall with bougainvillea and a low planted bed on the left and a lawn strip with strelitzia plants and a white kerb on the right, with cars and a covered motorbike parked beyond.

IMG_2474.jpg.title: Dalí car park and clipped hedge
IMG_2474.jpg.observation: An asphalt parking area with white bay lines faces a long clipped hedge on a white-edged kerb. A tiled-roof white villa and tall eucalyptus trees stand beyond the hedge.

IMG_2475.jpg.title: Calle Pintor Dalí looking south
IMG_2475.jpg.observation: A wide asphalt road with perpendicular parking on the left and a tall clipped hedge on a white kerb on the right, receding to the south with street lamps and distant sea light.

IMG_2476.jpg.title: Calle Pintor Dalí looking north
IMG_2476.jpg.observation: Asphalt road with parked cars on the right, a hedge on a white-edged kerb on the left, and white and grey two-storey apartment frontages ahead along the east side.

IMG_2477.jpg.title: House frontage on Dalí with arched entry and bougainvillea
IMG_2477.jpg.observation: A two-storey white house with an arched doorway, an iron-grilled window with dark shutters, a black-railed balcony, wall lanterns and heavy bougainvillea. A palm and shrubs sit at the left, a terracotta footpath edge and a grass strip in front, and a covered motorbike and car in the foreground.

IMG_2478.jpg.title: White arched gateway with lanterns into a planted passage
IMG_2478.jpg.observation: A white round-arched gateway with a stepped surround and two wall lanterns frames a tiled passage with large potted plants, a drain grate across the threshold and a lit lane beyond. A terracotta apron with a small step leads up to it, with a white wall and plants on the right.

IMG_2480.jpg.title: Paseo looking east with solar lamp and sandstone wall
IMG_2480.jpg.observation: A pink stamped-concrete promenade curves ahead beside a stone-clad retaining wall topped with green mesh screening on the left, with a white pole lamp with a solar-panel head, a rough grass verge with a concrete drain collar on the right and the beach and distant mountains beyond. Beach buildings with a red awning appear in the distance.

IMG_2484.jpg.title: Paseo near Calle Guillermo with painted crossing
IMG_2484.jpg.observation: The pink paseo bends north-east past a sandstone wall with green steel mesh fence, behind which is the main pool lawn and a white wall. A red-and-white painted crossing stripe lies across the path and a white lamp post, strollers and a beach building with a red awning stand ahead; a hotel block is visible in the distance.

IMG_2485.jpg.title: Comunidad Villacana gate sign at the end of Calle Guillermo
IMG_2485.jpg.observation: A white gate pillar with an iron gate and a white wall carrying a board reading COMUNIDAD VILLACANA ZONA PRIVADA, with a blue CCTV (videovigilada) notice and an alarm box. A yellow-green plumbago shrub in flower sits in front; the main pool lawn is glimpsed through the gate.

IMG_2486.jpg.title: Tiled apron at the foot of Calle Guillermo with curved wall
IMG_2486.jpg.observation: A terracotta-tiled paved apron with a few lighter tiles opens beside a white tapering curved wall with a decorative perforated block, a grass edge with a green bollard light, and white walls with trimmed shrubs and a steel mesh fence beyond.

IMG_2487.jpg.title: Curving tiled path beside a white house and planter wall
IMG_2487.jpg.observation: A terracotta path with diagonal tile lines curves between a white house wall with a brown-framed window, an arched hood, a black pergola beam and a mesh grille on the left, and a white planter wall with lavender and shrubs on the right. A banana plant and a street lamp stand behind.

IMG_2489.jpg.title: Calle Patricia lane with azulejo-backed white bench
IMG_2489.jpg.observation: A narrow lane paved with octagonal terracotta tiles with drain grates runs between white low walls with clipped hedges and a street lamp. A built-in white bench with a blue-and-yellow azulejo back and a strip of red brick paving sit on the right.

IMG_2491.jpg.title: Calle Patricia lane toward Teodoro Rojo
IMG_2491.jpg.observation: An octagonal-tile terracotta lane runs between a white wall with a hedge on the right and a low white wall with planting on the left. A white house with a pergola, a wooden garage-type door and climbing bougainvillea rises at the end, with a palm at the left.

IMG_2492.jpg.title: Calle de Teodoro street sign and arched wooden door
IMG_2492.jpg.observation: A white wall carries black tiles spelling CALLE DE TEODORO, with a white mailbox with a bin icon, a planter and bougainvillea. An arched dark-wood plank door with a white surround stands to the right; the paving is terracotta with a red drain grate.

IMG_2493.jpg.title: Calle Teodoro Rojo narrow lane looking north
IMG_2493.jpg.observation: A narrow terracotta-paved lane between tall white walls with drain grates, and a three-step stair with terracotta treads and white risers and planter on the left. Wall lanterns, a barred door, bougainvillea and a utility cabinet door are on the walls.

IMG_2495.jpg.title: Teodoro Rojo lane with barred window and arched doorway
IMG_2495.jpg.observation: A narrow terracotta lane runs north beside a white house with a green iron-barred window with shutters, a wall lantern and an arched recessed doorway, opposite a tall white wall and a clipped hedge. A drain grate and covered entries lead toward a planted opening at the end.

IMG_2496.jpg.title: Calle Teodoro 2-16 sign over stepped entrance
IMG_2496.jpg.observation: Black tile lettering CALLE TEODORO 2 16 on a white wall above a plinth with a service hatch. Three terracotta-tiled steps with white nosings lead up past a maroon studded ramp mat to a covered tiled porch with dark panelled doors.

IMG_2497.jpg.title: Covered tiled porch with arch and potted shrubs
IMG_2497.jpg.observation: Looking into a covered entrance porch with a patterned terracotta tile floor with inset motifs, a pebble doormat, a hanging lantern and heavy dark panelled doors on the right. Two potted clipped shrubs stand in front of a round arch that frames a garden beyond; three white-nosed steps and a studded maroon ramp mat lead up in front.

IMG_2498.jpg.title: Rear gardens with timber pergolas and white houses
IMG_2498.jpg.observation: A garden of hibiscus and clipped hedges with white low planter walls and a brown wooden gate in front of two-storey white houses with reed-roofed timber pergolas and small terraces.

IMG_2499.jpg.title: Grass path between white walls and hedges
IMG_2499.jpg.observation: A narrow grass path runs between low white planter walls topped with dense hedges and wooden gates, with trees, a date palm and a reed-roof pergola house beyond.

IMG_2500.jpg.title: Grass garden path with wooden gates
IMG_2500.jpg.observation: A grass strip between white planter walls with hedges and wooden slat gates, jacaranda-like trees and a pruned palm at the end, and a pergola house at left.

IMG_2501.jpg.title: Open tiled court at the Teodoro Rojo and Eva junction
IMG_2501.jpg.observation: A terracotta-paved space with red drain covers and a slot drain runs between white walls with utility cabinet doors and a doorway with bougainvillea, toward a clipped hedge and two-storey white houses with a balcony and tiled eaves.

IMG_2502.jpg.title: Magnolia and clipped hedge in front of a white house
IMG_2502.jpg.observation: A clipped hedge and a large rounded magnolia-type tree stand in front of a white house with a terracotta tiled roof, chimney, arched windows and bougainvillea.

IMG_2503.jpg.title: Eva tiled footpath beside lawn with magnolia and lamp post
IMG_2503.jpg.observation: A terracotta footpath with grey joints runs beside a white kerb and a lawn with an oleander hedge and a tall magnolia, with a green lamp post. Beyond is a white wall with bougainvillea and a shuttered window.

IMG_2504.jpg.title: Long tiled path to an arched iron gate
IMG_2504.jpg.observation: A long terracotta path edged by a white kerb with gravel strip runs between a flowering shrub hedge and a lawn toward a white wall with an open black iron gate, with bougainvillea and a white house with shuttered balconies beyond.

IMG_2505.jpg.title: Middle pool lawn: flagstone path, clipped hedge and glass pool fence
IMG_2505.jpg.observation: Looking west across the lawn of the middle pool: an irregular flagstone path curves between a clipped hedge on a white curved kerb and the lawn, a frameless glass fence with steel handrails and a pool step edge the pool at left, and a large feathery tree and palm stand in front of white two-storey houses with arched shuttered windows, balconies, umbrellas and bougainvillea. A low bollard light stands at the path edge.

IMG_2506.jpg.title: Elena south lane: terracotta tiles past doors with red-tread steps
IMG_2506.jpg.observation: Narrow lane paved in large terracotta tiles with grey grout, white rendered house walls with brown timber doors each with a red-tiled step, a wall lantern, trained climbers and clipped shrubs in a planting strip on the right, and a bougainvillea-filled courtyard at the far end.

IMG_2509.jpg.title: Elena south lane: tiled path beside curved white kerb and lawn
IMG_2509.jpg.observation: Terracotta-tiled path with a rounded white kerb on the left edging a lawn and clipped shrub, and on the right a white house wall with climbing plants, flowering ground cover, an iron-railed gate and a red-capped low wall. Ahead a white raised step and low wall, a timber door and a balconied house with brown shutters and bougainvillea.

IMG_2510.jpg.title: Elena lane: green iron-barred wall and gate beside a hedged garden
IMG_2510.jpg.observation: Looking up the tiled lane with a rounded white kerb and lawn on the left and a pollarded tree by a low white wall and timber door; on the right a white wall with a moulded coping and green wrought-iron bars, a hedge and bougainvillea. A balconied house with a tiled roof and street lamp stands beyond.

IMG_2511.jpg.title: Elena/Cervantes junction: steps beside the ramp, lawn with manhole cover
IMG_2511.jpg.observation: Terracotta lane with a rounded white kerb along a lawn that carries a round manhole cover; at the far side short white steps with a red-tiled ramp strip rise to a white-walled garden with a pollarded bush, a timber door under a moulded hood and a balcony with shutters, and bougainvillea. A grating crosses the lane at the foot of the steps and part of an ELENA sign is at left edge.

IMG_2512.jpg.title: Cervantes lane looking east: lantana hedge and white boundary wall
IMG_2512.jpg.observation: Straight terracotta-tiled lane with a tall lantana and shrub hedge spilling over a white wall on the right, a white wall with a closed door and domed coping beyond, a planter wall and flowering shrubs on the left, and houses with bougainvillea. A car is visible at the distant end of the lane.

IMG_2513.jpg.title: Cervantes lane: long white wall with timber door and domed coping
IMG_2513.jpg.observation: Narrow terracotta lane running away between a tall white rendered wall on the right, containing a tall timber door in a rounded moulded arch with a red-tile sill, and low walls with planting, bougainvillea and houses on the left, with a grey aggregate margin along the wall foot.

IMG_2514.jpg.title: Elena north lane foot: hedged planting bed, red drain grating and aggregate margin
IMG_2514.jpg.observation: Hedged bed on a raised white kerb with a pollarded tree trunk, drip lines on bare soil and young shrubs; a white garden wall with a timber door and curved coping behind. In the lane a red-painted ribbed drain grating crosses the path, with terracotta tiles and a grey aggregate strip beside the kerb. The photographer's shadow is on the paving.

IMG_2515.jpg.title: Elena north lane: tiled path between hedged beds towards the arched gateway
IMG_2515.jpg.observation: Straight terracotta-tiled path with grey aggregate margins between a barred, climber-covered house frontage with lantern and planters on the left, and hedged beds with white kerbs, spider plants and two magnolia-type trees on the right. A white wall with a shuttered window and a low arched gateway with an open iron gate closes the far end.

IMG_2516.jpg.title: Elena north lane closer to the gateway: hedged beds, bars and lantern
IMG_2516.jpg.observation: Closer view up the same tiled lane: a white arched house portico with iron-barred window and lantern and a planter on the left; on the right a hedge-bordered bed of spider plants and young plants in soil, two trees, a white wall with a moulded-surround shuttered window, a timber door at right and the arched gateway with iron gate and lawn beyond.

IMG_2517.jpg.title: Elena covered walkway east portal: plaque, steps and red ribbed ramp
IMG_2517.jpg.observation: A white arched portal holds a black-numbered plaque reading ELENA 18 36, white steps clad in terracotta beside a red ribbed ramp, a lantern and iron-barred window; the lane ahead is terracotta-tiled with a grey aggregate margin and ends at an open iron gate to a lawn. A utility cover is set in the wall.

IMG_2520.jpg.title: Elena covered walkway: patterned tile floor with pebble mosaic panel
IMG_2520.jpg.observation: Inside a vaulted white passage with doors on both sides and a lantern, the floor is terracotta with blue-and-white inset tiles in a herringbone/offset pattern and a rectangular pebble mosaic panel; potted shrubs flank the way to a round arch opening onto a courtyard with iron gates and planting.

IMG_2521.jpg.title: Elena covered walkway: round arch to the 36/34 gates, potted shrubs
IMG_2521.jpg.observation: Looking through a round white arch past two large potted shrubs and a shuttered window to a courtyard with two iron gates numbered 36 and 34 and climbing plants; the floor is terracotta with blue-and-white inset tiles and a wall utility cabinet is at left.

IMG_2522.jpg.title: Brown timber house door with green iron grille
IMG_2522.jpg.observation: Close-up of a panelled brown timber door with a small square green wrought-iron grille, a brass knob, a key-fob reader box and a light switch on the white wall; a red tile threshold at the base.

IMG_2523.jpg.title: Doormat with blue-and-white lion tile border on terracotta threshold
IMG_2523.jpg.observation: Looking down at a coir doormat set into a border of blue-and-white lion-motif tiles in a terracotta floor, in front of a brown timber door with a white threshold strip; a photographer's feet are in frame and one blue-and-white inset tile is visible lower left.

IMG_2524.jpg.title: Dali car park looking south: white kerb, chain-link fence, houses at far end
IMG_2524.jpg.observation: Asphalt car park with parked cars along the left, a white-painted concrete kerb on the right edged by a tall chain-link fence with trees and shrubs behind, a white wall inside the fence, and white houses with arched shuttered windows, street lamp and banana plants at the far end with a strip of sea light beyond.

IMG_2525.jpg.title: Dali car park bays and the white houses along its east side
IMG_2525.jpg.observation: Looking south-east across the asphalt car park with white bay lines and parked cars; behind them white two-storey houses with arched shuttered windows, wall lamps, banana plants and bougainvillea, and a palm at the far end. The asphalt is a fine grey aggregate surface.

IMG_2526.jpg.title: Dali car park looking north: hedge-covered fence, white kerb and parked cars
IMG_2526.jpg.observation: Wide asphalt aisle with a white-painted kerb on the left against a tall hedge and fence, a row of parked cars on the right in bays marked with white lines, and white houses with arches, a street lamp and palms at the north end.

IMG_2537.jpg.title: House entrance porch with arched door numbered 22 and patterned tile floor
IMG_2537.jpg.observation: A white-walled entrance recess with a brown arched timber door carrying the number 22 and a small green iron grille, a second brown panelled door beside it, shuttered window, key-reader boxes and a switch on the walls. The floor is terracotta with blue-and-white inset tiles in an offset grid, a small patterned mat at the door and a coir mat with lion-tile border in the foreground.

IMG_2538.jpg.title: Elena covered walkway looking out of its east portal to the lane, plaque CALLE ELENA 18 36
IMG_2538.jpg.observation: From inside a vaulted white passage with a dark timber door at right, a round arch frames the lane outside: a magnolia-type tree in a hedged bed, a white garden wall with a barred, shuttered window and bougainvillea, and a red ribbed ramp beside terracotta steps at the portal. The plaque CALLE ELENA 18 36 is on the left wall and part of a pebble mosaic panel is at the lower left; the floor is terracotta with blue-and-white inset tiles in an offset pattern.

IMG_2540.jpg.title: Cervantes/Elena junction: steps beside the ramp, kerbs and drain
IMG_2540.jpg.observation: Looking along the Cervantes lane over a ribbed drain grating and two grey stone inset slabs to three shallow steps beside a ramp strip of terracotta tile, both flanked by white rendered kerbs, a tall clipped hedge and bougainvillea; a CALLE ELENA sign is on a white wall at left with a pollarded tree and lawn, and a balconied house stands beyond. A white step with a red tile top is at the right foreground.

IMG_2541.jpg.title: Cervantes inner walk-through: arch signed CALLE MIGUEL, benches, pebble mat
IMG_2541.jpg.observation: Looking south-south-east into a covered entrance under a flat ceiling with a hanging lantern: a wall sign reading CALLE MIGUEL (de Cervantes), dark double timber doors, a schefflera plant, a rounded arch, a black timber bench, a pebble mosaic mat and a terracotta floor with blue-and-white inset tiles leading to a lane with stone paving and planting beyond.

IMG_2542.jpg.title: Cervantes inner walk-through: pebble mosaic and blue-and-white inset tiles
IMG_2542.jpg.observation: Close view down the covered entrance: a rectangular pebble mosaic panel set in a terracotta floor scattered with blue-and-white tiles (ships, animals, monograms), a black timber bench and planted tubs ahead, dark panelled doors on both sides and stone paving in the sunlit lane beyond.

IMG_2543.jpg.title: Inner walk-through looking south-east through a round arch
IMG_2543.jpg.observation: From under a round pink-washed arch, a narrow lane of terracotta and white-inset tiles runs between white two-storey houses with iron balconies and barred windows, planters, bougainvillea, climbers, banana-type plants and wall lanterns, towards a tiled-roof house with an arch at the far end.

IMG_2544.jpg.title: Inner walk-through lane: white houses, bougainvillea and a far arch
IMG_2544.jpg.observation: Wider view of the same lane from the arch: white rendered houses with tall arched recesses, black iron balconies and barred windows, a lantern, large planting beds with leafy tropical plants, a tiled floor with scattered inset tiles, and a tiled-roof house and archway at the far end.

IMG_2545.jpg.title: Inner walk-through bend: white walls, planter box, drain grating and manhole
IMG_2545.jpg.observation: A white rendered wall with a pointed arched window, a stepped moulded cornice and a tall timber door; a raised white planter holds jasmine-type shrubs and a small tree, and the tiled lane has a slot drain and a round cover, leading on to a tile-roofed house with a balcony and arch. A banana leaf overhangs at top left.

IMG_2546.jpg.title: Inner walk-through south end: lantern arch, monstera planting and inset tiles
IMG_2546.jpg.observation: Looking down a lane between white houses (one numbered 16) under a wall lantern toward an arched covered section with a hanging lamp and a door; terracotta floor with sparse blue-and-white inset tiles, white-kerbed planting beds with monstera, glossy shrubs and flowering plants.

IMG_2547.jpg.title: Inner walk-through covered section: double doors, pebble mat and tile inset floor
IMG_2547.jpg.observation: Inside a vaulted white covered passage: a dark panelled double door on the left, a door with keypad lock on the right, a hanging lantern, two potted trees, a pebble mosaic mat and a door mat, and a terracotta floor with blue-and-white inset tiles; daylight ahead shows a white wall with a barred window and bougainvillea.

IMG_2548.jpg.title: Covered tiled passage off Calle Eva with brown double door and potted trees
IMG_2548.jpg.observation: A white-rendered covered passage with a terracotta floor patterned with blue-and-white azulejo inserts and a dark pebble mat. Dark brown double doors on the left, a recessed arched door and a keypad lock on the right, a hanging lantern, two potted trees, and an arched opening at the far end showing bougainvillea and a barred window.

IMG_2550.jpg.title: Arched timber double gate in a white wall, Calle Eva/Dali corner
IMG_2550.jpg.observation: A tall arched, vertically boarded timber double gate with a lever handle and a wall lamp above, set in a white rendered curved-top wall topped with climbers and palms. A low white-edged clipped hedge bed runs to the right, and square terracotta tiles with pale grout form the landing in front.

IMG_2551.jpg.title: Calle Eva west footpath at the Dali end, terracotta path beside a lawn island
IMG_2551.jpg.observation: A terracotta-tiled footpath with white kerbs runs away from the camera between a clipped bed on the left and a grass island on the right, with a strelitzia, a green street lamp and a bollard. Beyond is the Dali car park and a low wall with chain-link and ivy; a wheeled cleaning cart stands on the path and a white pier on the right carries part of a 'CALLE' sign.

IMG_2552.jpg.title: Curved kerbed footpath meeting the Dali car park aisle
IMG_2552.jpg.observation: A terracotta footpath bends along a curved white kerb beside a lawn, with a drain grille and a crack in the paving. Beyond is the Dali car-park aisle with marked bays, a green lamp post, and a retaining wall with ivy, bougainvillea and chain-link behind.

IMG_2553.jpg.title: Calle Eva west footpath looking east between white houses and a planted bed
IMG_2553.jpg.observation: A terracotta footpath with a white kerb on the left runs between white houses on the left and a long walled planting bed (hedge edge, soil, shrubs) on the right. House fronts have arched windows and brown doors; bougainvillea, banana-type plants and a palm line the lane and a pergola of pink flowers closes the distance.

IMG_2554.jpg.title: Dali car park looking north with CCTV lamp post and parked cars
IMG_2554.jpg.observation: A tall dark-green pole with two white CCTV cameras stands in the foreground by a grass island with a white painted kerb. Parked cars line a bay along the left fence (chain-link with climbers) and mixed trees and palms stand beyond; mountains are visible far off.

IMG_2555.jpg.title: Dali car park edge with lawn islands and white house with brown gate
IMG_2555.jpg.observation: A parked car on asphalt beside a grass island with a white kerb, and service covers set in the lawn. Behind it a white wall with a brown timber gate, bougainvillea and strelitzia fronts a two-storey white house with a tiled eave, a wooden balcony and arched windows.

IMG_2556.jpg.title: Footpath along the west side of the block, house with grilled windows
IMG_2556.jpg.observation: A terracotta footpath with a white kerb runs south-east along a house front on the left (white render, grilled windows, bougainvillea, black lanterns, balcony and tiled eave) and a grass verge and the Dali road with a parked car on the right. A brown gate and lamp posts show in the distance.

IMG_2557.jpg.title: Arched covered passage with blue-and-white tiled floor and a 'CALLE MART...' sign
IMG_2557.jpg.observation: An arched, vaulted-style covered passage with a lantern, potted ficus trees on both sides, brown doors with barred windows, and a patterned floor of terracotta squares with blue-and-white azulejo inserts and a dark pebble mat. A second arch leads to a gate at the far end, and a blue-and-white street plaque reading 'CALLE MART...' (cut off) is on the right wall.

IMG_2558.jpg.title: Terracotta footpath with kerbed planters leading to a brown gate
IMG_2558.jpg.observation: A wide terracotta-tiled footpath with white kerbs runs ahead between a planted bed under a white house with a grilled window and bougainvillea, and a hedged bed beside the car park. A white-walled brown timber gate and a lamp post stand at the far end.

IMG_2560.jpg.title: Calle Patricia west end: narrow terracotta lane between high white walls
IMG_2560.jpg.observation: A long straight terracotta-tiled lane between white garden walls with a brown door in the left wall, climbing bougainvillea, a euphorbia cactus and a twisted vine trunk over the right wall, a post box on the right wall and bedding along the foot. A tall conifer and lamp posts are at the far end.

IMG_2561.jpg.title: Arched entrance of the Patricia covered passage with lanterns
IMG_2561.jpg.observation: A white arched opening with two black wall lanterns leads into a covered passage with a terracotta floor and blue inserts; a second arch is visible beyond. In the foreground is a terracotta-paved path with a drain grille, a strip of lawn with rock and agave to the right, and clipped shrubs against the white pier.

IMG_2562.jpg.title: Arch marked 'CALLE DE PATRICIA' at the start of the covered passage
IMG_2562.jpg.observation: A large rendered arch with a hanging lantern, shrubs in white planters and climbing vines frames a covered tiled passage with several further arches. A black-on-white enamel sign on the right pier reads 'CALLE DE PATRICIA' with house numbers (apparently 15 and 37).

IMG_2563.jpg.title: Patricia covered passage with brown doors and a pebble mosaic mat
IMG_2563.jpg.observation: A vaulted covered passage with two hanging lanterns, tall dark brown panelled doors on both sides, a barred window, potted plants in white planters, and a dark pebble mat set into the terracotta floor with blue-and-white tile inserts. Several arches continue to a brighter opening at the far end.

IMG_2564.jpg.title: Pebble mosaic with floral motif in the Patricia passage floor
IMG_2564.jpg.observation: A close view of a rectangular dark pebble mosaic with a white six-petal flower and dotted border set into a floor of terracotta squares with blue-and-white tile inserts (shells, stars, rosettes). A red drain cover, a drain grille, white planters and a ficus are on the sides.

IMG_2565.jpg.title: Patricia lane with planted beds, arched doors and a tiled-roof arch ahead
IMG_2565.jpg.observation: A terracotta lane with blue-and-white inserts between white walls with barred windows, arched recessed doors and numbered plaques; raised white planters hold dracaena, ferns and shrubs. A pale arch with a tiled roof and shuttered upper windows closes the view.

IMG_2566.jpg.title: Patricia lane columns, arch and bougainvillea
IMG_2566.jpg.observation: A paved lane with white columns on both sides, a bougainvillea-covered pergola and a hanging lantern leads to an arch with shuttered windows above; through it is a green screen and lawn. Terracotta floor with blue star inserts and white planters with agave, olive-like shrubs and spider plant.

IMG_2567.jpg.title: Patricia lane arch with tiled eave, shutters and bougainvillea (looking up)
IMG_2567.jpg.observation: Looking up a narrow white-walled lane at a terrace with a curved terracotta roof-tile edge over a shuttered upper room, black balcony rails on the left, a hanging lantern, lush bougainvillea and an arch leading to a garden at the bottom.

IMG_2568.jpg.title: Patricia passage: arch, doors, grilles and a green-netted garden beyond
IMG_2568.jpg.observation: A broad arch with a hanging lantern and climbing vine opens to a covered section with brown doors, black window grilles and white planters of shrubs; a second arch frames a lawn with green netting. Floor is terracotta with blue-and-white inserts and a drain grille.

IMG_2569.jpg.title: Last arch of the Patricia passage with pebble mat and ramp to a lawn
IMG_2569.jpg.observation: A lantern-lit arch frames a lawn and flowering plants seen over a green netting screen. In front is a dark pebble mat set in a terracotta floor with blue-and-white inserts, then a red studded rubber ramp mat between white planters, and a brown panelled door on the right.

IMG_2570.jpg.title: Passage exit with tiled steps, red ramp mat and white planter walls
IMG_2570.jpg.observation: The tiled passage ends at a short run of steps and a red studded ramp bounded by rounded white planter walls with clipped shrubs, with a wall sign plate on the right. A lawn and oleander, yellow flowers, a fence and a green netting screen are beyond. A drain cover and blue-and-white tiles are in the foreground.

IMG_2571.jpg.title: Garden bed with oleander beside the passage exit, from behind a white pier
IMG_2571.jpg.observation: From behind a white rendered pier, a lawn with a terracotta path, a bed of oleander with yellow flowers edged with green netting, clipped hedges and a gate in a fence. White two-storey townhouses with banana plants and a patio chair are behind.

IMG_2573.jpg.title: Oleander hedge, lawn and white townhouse with balcony beside the path
IMG_2573.jpg.observation: A row of oleander shrubs lines a terracotta path with a lawn beyond; a white townhouse corner with a black balcony rail, dark window and door, a clipped hedge, an air-conditioning unit and a worn lower plinth stands behind.

IMG_2574.jpg.title: Tiled steps and red studded ramp at the passage exit, planter wall to the right
IMG_2574.jpg.observation: Three white-rendered steps with terracotta treads edged with a dark grey line, beside a red studded rubber ramp. A rounded white planter wall with succulents runs along, and a dark door sits in the recess of the white wall behind.

IMG_2575.jpg.title: Steps, ramp and planter wall seen from the Silvia lane side
IMG_2575.jpg.observation: The same three terracotta-tiled steps and red studded ramp seen from the side, with a white pier with step-back capping, a long white planter wall with shrubs and a small hatch in the wall, and a wide terracotta lane receding to the north-west.

IMG_2576.jpg.title: Narrow lane to an open iron gate and the grass at the end, between oleander and planter
IMG_2576.jpg.observation: A narrow terracotta lane between an oleander bed on the left and a white wall with a barred, shuttered window and a raised white planter on the right leads to a white wall with an arched opening and two open black iron gate leaves. A notice and blue pictogram plates are on the gate pier; lawn and a red lifebuoy are visible beyond.

IMG_2577.jpg.title: Iron gate with notices at the end of the lane, planted wall on the right
IMG_2577.jpg.observation: A terracotta lane with a worn paving patch leads to an open iron double gate set in an arched white wall. Pictogram signs and a notice board are fixed to the gate pier; barred black railings and a raised planter with a tiled coping are to the right, oleanders to the left; lawn and sea-side green are visible beyond.

IMG_2578.jpg.title: Calle Teodoro Rojo/Silvia lane: terracotta path beside a white wall with grilles
IMG_2578.jpg.observation: A wide terracotta-paved lane with grey grout and a planter strip runs alongside a white house wall with black barred windows, a geranium bed and rendered planter, with a hedge, white pillar, lamp posts and a palm on the left. A small utility vehicle stands far along the lane, and mountains show in the distance.

IMG_2579.jpg.title: Tiled lane with white planter walls and barred windows, looking ENE
IMG_2579.jpg.observation: Terracotta square-tile lane running ENE between a white rendered planter wall with clipped hedge on the left and ground-floor windows with black iron grilles and brown shutters on the right. A white-rendered ledge/sill wall steps along the right side; a lawn, a lamp post and a lawn mower stand at the far end.

IMG_2580.jpg.title: Narrow tiled lane between white houses, planters and an iron gate at the end
IMG_2580.jpg.observation: Looking SSE down a narrow terracotta-tile lane: a plain textured white wall on the left, on the right house fronts with a wall lantern, arched opening, brown door, barred shutter window, and white rendered planter walls with clipped shrubs and bougainvillea petals on the tiles. At the far end an iron railing/gate, hedge and lawn show above a small stepped drain or stair.

IMG_2581.jpg.title: Arched porch entrance with three tiled steps and a street-name plaque
IMG_2581.jpg.observation: Looking south into a white rendered arched porch: two bays of a round arch on thick square piers with a stepped base, three terracotta-tiled steps with white risers rising to the porch floor, a red ribbed rubber ramp beside them and a drain grating in the tiled paving. Black lettering on the back wall reads 'CALLE DE T...' (rest hidden). Iron-barred windows and a hedge at left.

IMG_2582.jpg.title: Covered passage with brown doors, patterned tile floor and a courtyard arch beyond
IMG_2582.jpg.observation: Looking SW along a covered passage with white rendered walls and ceiling, a hanging black lantern, brown double doors on both sides and potted plants. The terracotta floor has small blue-and-white inserts stepping diagonally; a ribbed red rubber ramp lies in the foreground and an arched opening at the far end shows a tree in a white courtyard.

IMG_2583.jpg.title: Courtyard seen through an arch: bougainvillea, balconies and patterned tile floor
IMG_2583.jpg.observation: Looking SSW from under a round arch into a small white courtyard: terracotta floor with blue-and-white insert tiles and a slot drain, white planter edging with shrubs, palms and a yellow-green bush, bougainvillea climbing the right wall, wall lantern, an arched window with shutters, a balcony with shutters and iron rail at upper level, and an arched door.

IMG_2584.jpg.title: Covered passage with hanging lanterns and an arched iron gate to a lawn
IMG_2584.jpg.observation: Looking SSE along a white covered passage with two hanging black lanterns, tall brown doors on both sides, arched niches, and white planters with spider plants along both walls. The terracotta floor has diagonal blue-and-white insert tiles. At the far end an arch with a fan-light iron gate opens on to a hedge and lawn.

IMG_2585.jpg.title: Covered passage looking NNW to an arch and courtyard
IMG_2585.jpg.observation: Looking NW along the same passage: lantern hung from the vaulted ceiling, brown double door on the left, a coir/stone doormat and a potted palm on the tiled floor, and an arch at the far end opening on to a courtyard with clipped hedge and a shuttered door. Floor has blue-and-white insert tiles.

IMG_2587.jpg.title: Tile floor with blue-and-white crest inserts between raised white planters
IMG_2587.jpg.observation: Looking ENE along a terracotta-tile walkway: square red tiles are laid in offset blocks with blue-and-white decorated insert tiles (shields, crests, anchor motif) at regular intervals, between raised white rendered planter beds with leafy plants.

IMG_2588.jpg.title: Tiled courtyard with raised planters and an arched covered entrance
IMG_2588.jpg.observation: Looking NE across a terracotta courtyard with blue-and-white inserts: leafy shrubs in a left-hand bed, a white rendered raised planter at the back with a potted tree, and an arched opening leading into a covered passage with a pale double door.

IMG_2589.jpg.title: Arched porch with potted plants, drain grating and double door
IMG_2589.jpg.observation: Looking NNE under a round white arch on stepped piers into a porch: terracotta floor with scattered blue-and-white inserts, a rust slot drain in the foreground, two large potted schefflera, a barred window, a pale double door and a wall lantern. A second arch shows at the right.

IMG_2590.jpg.title: Covered porch with arch, pale double door and hanging lantern
IMG_2590.jpg.observation: Looking NE past a white arched pier into a covered porch with a vaulted/rendered ceiling, a hanging lantern, a pale panelled double door, a second arched opening at the end and large potted schefflera on the patterned terracotta floor.

IMG_2591.jpg.title: Covered passage with brown double doors and a doormat, arch to a white wall
IMG_2591.jpg.observation: Looking ENE along a covered passage: tall brown panelled doors on both sides, a hanging lantern, small plaques on the right wall, a coir/pebble doormat on the blue-and-white inserted tile floor, a potted plant and an arch at the end opening to a white wall and a small terracotta landing with steps.

IMG_2592.jpg.title: View out of an arch to a small white court with a ribbed ramp and step
IMG_2592.jpg.observation: Looking ENE through a round arch on stepped piers: a ribbed red rubber ramp and a low step lead up to a small terracotta landing in front of a roughly rendered white wall with a small window, with a potted plant and some tile inserts in the shadowed foreground.

IMG_2593.jpg.title: Narrow tiled lane between white walls, looking NNW
IMG_2593.jpg.observation: A long straight terracotta-tile lane runs NNW between a rough white rendered wall on the right (with a meter cabinet) and low white planter walls, hedges and house fronts on the left. A lamp post, yucca palm and a bougainvillea-covered tree stand along it; a slightly lighter patch of tiles with grates crosses the lane in the middle distance.

IMG_2594.jpg.title: Lane between white houses with lamp post, yucca palm and Norfolk pine, looking NNW
IMG_2594.jpg.observation: Looking NNW along the same lane a metre or two further on: a rough white wall with a small panelled cabinet on the right, hedge-topped white planter walls and a flat-roofed white house with a dark pergola on the left, a lamp post, a spiky-leaf palm and a Norfolk pine in the distance. Paving is terracotta squares with darker red grating/insert patches.

IMG_2595.jpg.title: Tiled path along lawns towards white houses with chimneys, looking ENE
IMG_2595.jpg.observation: Wide terracotta-tile path running ENE with white rendered walls topped by hedges on the left and open lawn with side paths on the right. Beyond are white houses with tall chimney pots and stepped parapets, a euphorbia cactus, flowering shrubs and lamp posts; a date palm and distant mountain show on the horizon.

IMG_2596.jpg.title: White tiled bench, cast manhole covers and terracotta paving
