IMG_2596.jpg.observation: Close view looking NNE: a chunky white rendered bench with a blue-and-yellow Valencian tile panel on its back, white planter blocks beyond it, and terracotta paving with two cast-iron covers (a round one reading 'SANEAM...' and a square ribbed one). A band of smaller red brick-style tiles borders the bench.

IMG_2597.jpg.title: Calle de Jorge sign post beside the lawn wall and tiled path, mountain beyond
IMG_2597.jpg.observation: A white rendered post with black lettering 'CALLE DE JORGE' stands at a curving terracotta-tile path next to a lawn and an olive tree. Beyond a low white wall with orange lantana the lawn leads to a hedge, a white wall, a multi-storey hotel block and a mountain on the horizon; a lamp post stands at the corner.

IMG_2598.jpg.title: Lawn and flowering lantana border looking east to the Barraka restaurant
IMG_2598.jpg.observation: From the end of Calle Jorge: a lantana bed with yellow flowers along a white wall in the foreground, a wide lawn with a pink path, bollard lights and a bin, a dark green metal fence with a hedge, and beyond it a long low building with a tiled roof, horizontal windows, red awnings and a solar water heater. Strelitzia leaves frame the right edge.

IMG_2599.jpg.title: Curved white-walled tiled descent at the foot of the lane to the beach fence
IMG_2599.jpg.observation: Looking SE down a terracotta-tile ramp-like path that curves between tall white rendered walls with lower stepped walls on the right; wet tiles in diagonal flagstone pattern near the bottom. Beyond are hedges, a green mesh fence, a yucca, a lamp post and a strip of beach.

IMG_2601.jpg.title: Tiled landing at the foot of the lane with hedge and green fence to the beach
IMG_2601.jpg.observation: Looking ESE over a square terracotta-tile landing flanked by white rendered walls on the left and a grey-green hedge on the right, ending at a clipped hedge and a dark green welded-mesh fence. Beyond are scrub, sand, thatched beach parasols and palms.

IMG_2602.jpg.title: Arched white gate pillar with iron gate, signs and bollard light at the lawn corner
IMG_2602.jpg.observation: Looking NE from the paseo end of the lane: a white rendered gate pier with a rounded cap and a tall black iron gate with circular motifs and signs, flanked by a white wall and a clipped hedge, beside a green mesh fence. Pink and terracotta paving with a bollard light, lawn on the left, and the Barraka restaurant building with a solar heater behind.

IMG_2603.jpg.title: Pink lawn path with bollard lights and a pool-side white curved-roof building
IMG_2603.jpg.observation: Looking NNW from the paseo end across the lawn: a pink-red path forks across grass with green bollard lights and a bin, leading to a white building with swept curved roof planes, blue signs and glazing, with a glass-fenced pool in front. A tall date palm stands at left and a multi-storey block rises behind.

IMG_2604.jpg.title: Paseo past the Barraka restaurant with lamp post and lounge seating
IMG_2604.jpg.observation: Looking ENE along the pink-red paving of the paseo beside a dark green fence on a sandstone-block wall; on the right a dry grass area with rope barriers and rattan lounge seating, and ahead the Barraka restaurant: pale walls, row of brown-framed windows, red awnings, a tiled roof with a solar heater. A white solar lamp post stands on the left.

IMG_2605.jpg.title: View through the Barraka terrace rail to beach parasols and palms
IMG_2605.jpg.observation: Looking SSE from a restaurant terrace past a white timber rail, a dark table and a white chair: sand, a blue-painted timber boardwalk, thatched parasols with loungers, banana-like leafy plants and tall palms.

IMG_2606.jpg.title: Barraka terrace looking ESE over the beach, parasols and boardwalk
IMG_2606.jpg.observation: From under a terrace awning with white posts and rails: moulded white chair and table in front, rail beyond, sand with a blue timber boardwalk, thatched parasols with low wooden loungers and a canvas windbreak on the horizon.

IMG_2607.jpg.title: From the Barraka terrace over rattan lounge seating and the paseo
IMG_2607.jpg.observation: Under a dark scalloped awning, looking SSW over a grass patch with rattan armchairs and sofa, an umbrella, an easel board, a potted plant, and the pink paseo curving past a dark green fence to white houses and palms; the sea is at left.

IMG_2608.jpg.title: From the Barraka terrace looking SW along the paseo to the white houses
IMG_2608.jpg.observation: Under dark scalloped awnings on a decked terrace with a white chair and table: grass with an easel board and rope barriers, the pink paseo bordered by a sandstone wall and dark green railings, and a row of white flat-roofed houses with palms and a Norfolk pine beyond.

IMG_2609.jpg.title: Barraka beach-side lounge garden looking south-west along the paseo
IMG_2609.jpg.observation: Dark red scalloped awnings and a timber deck with table and white chairs in the foreground; a roped-off grass lounge area with rattan armchairs, sofa, closed parasol, an easel sign and terracotta pots sits left of the pink stamped-concrete paseo. A sandstone-faced wall carries a green vertical-bar fence along the lawn on the right, with white houses, palms and a pine beyond.

IMG_2610.jpg.title: Barraka terrace paving, slot drain and curved sandstone wall under green railings
IMG_2610.jpg.observation: Pink stamped (board-marked) concrete terrace with a long black slot drain; a curved sandstone-faced wall runs behind it with a green vertical-bar railing on top, lawn and palms beyond, and white buildings with a hotel block on the skyline. A maroon awning edge with a white post, a white pot and a white chair frame the view.

IMG_2611.jpg.title: Paseo lane beside Barraka's north-west wall looking north-east
IMG_2611.jpg.observation: A pink stamped-concrete lane with green bar railings on a sandstone wall at left (the lawn) and Barraka's white wall with timber cladding, small slit windows, a red awning and a black glazed frontage at right. Sandbags lie along a slot drain at the wall foot; a lamp post, a blue 'Lisa's Shop' sign on a chain-link fence, olive trees and banana plants stand at the far end.

IMG_2612.jpg.title: Junction at Barraka's north corner: stone planter bed, bollard and Lisa's Shop sign
IMG_2612.jpg.observation: Looking north-east along the pink stamped paving past Barraka's white wall (right, timber cladding at its top). On the left a curved sandstone-faced planter wall with a blue-and-white bollard encloses grass and olive trees in front of a brick-faced single-storey building behind chain-link fencing with a blue 'Lisa's Shop' sign; beach and distant mountains are visible between the fence and the wall.

IMG_2613.jpg.title: Service lane between the main-pool lawn walls and the neighbouring building, looking north-west
IMG_2613.jpg.observation: A narrow concrete-and-asphalt lane runs north-west between a tall white rendered wall with a door and parapet planting (left) and a long white wall with stepped concrete canopy brackets over a low white kerb wall (right). A blue-and-white bollard, a drain grating across the lane, two parked bicycles and two walkers are in view, with cars and palm trees at the far end.

IMG_2614.jpg.title: Seaward aisle beside Barraka's north-east wall with strelitzia pots and stacked sunloungers
IMG_2614.jpg.observation: Looking south-east from the paseo corner down a concrete slab aisle onto the beach: three large terracotta pots of strelitzia, stacks of blue sunloungers against Barraka's white wall (brown-framed windows, timber band), green timber boardwalk planks at left and straw parasols on the sand.

IMG_2615.jpg.title: Barraka north-east elevation with brown-framed windows, timber band and black door
IMG_2615.jpg.observation: Close view of Barraka's white two-storey north-east wall: a horizontal brown timber band, two rows of brown-framed windows stepping down with the parapet, a louvred vent, a black door in a recess with a concrete step, a wall lamp, and stacked blue sunloungers and a strelitzia pot beside it. Concrete paving at left meets the pink stamped paving.

IMG_2617.jpg.title: Beach east of Barraka with parasols and sunloungers
IMG_2617.jpg.observation: Flat coarse sand with footprints and tufts of grass, a row of straw parasols over blue sunloungers on the horizon at right, a pole on the left and a white lounger at the right edge under an overcast sky.

IMG_2618.jpg.title: Barraka's north-east facade seen from the beach side of the paseo
IMG_2618.jpg.observation: Two-storey white building with rows of brown-framed windows, a brown timber band, a louvred vent, a rooftop water tank, a black door with a flat pot and strelitzia either side, stacked loungers, a white planter rack and a green timber walkway on sand; a pink paseo strip with a timber edge, a lamp and a sandstone wall with chain-link fence lead off to the right.

IMG_2619.jpg.title: Barraka thatched cooking shelter, net-covered mound and kayaks on the sand
IMG_2619.jpg.observation: A thatched-roof timber shelter with a white board wall stands on the sand with a large grey fishing-net-covered mound and stacked brown crates in front; red kayaks, white and blue sunloungers and a white planter rack with plants lie in the foreground, with Barraka's north-east wall and parasols behind.

IMG_2620.jpg.title: Beach in front of Barraka with parasol rows and kayaks
IMG_2620.jpg.observation: Looking south-east over coarse sand to long rows of straw parasols over blue sunloungers on the waterline side; red kayaks and a white lounger lie at right, and the edge of the thatched shelter shows at the far right.

IMG_2621.jpg.title: Paseo looking north-east past the sandstone wall and beach edge
IMG_2621.jpg.observation: A pink stamped-concrete walkway with a timber edge borders the beach on the right; a sandstone wall with chain-link fence and a lamp post runs along the left, two walkers ahead, palms, low coastal buildings and the sea and mountains in the distance.

IMG_2622.jpg.title: Paseo north-east of Barraka with white cottage behind chain-link fence
IMG_2622.jpg.observation: The pink paseo with a timber beach edge runs towards a distant row of palms; at left a yellow sandstone retaining wall and chain-link fence enclose a lawn and a single-storey white cottage with a pitched tile roof, brown door and palm tree.

IMG_2623.jpg.title: Closed building with canopy roof and empty forecourt behind chain-link fence
IMG_2623.jpg.observation: Across a sandstone wall, grass strip and chain-link fence stands a single-storey white building with a flat projecting canopy, dark base, peeling dark patches on its walls, brown double door and shallow steps, on an empty paved forecourt with a low planter and hotel blocks behind.

IMG_2624.jpg.title: Disused glazed building with deep canopy and curved planter
IMG_2624.jpg.observation: Chain link and a sandstone wall frame a view of a long single-storey building with a deep concrete canopy and dark glazed frontage at left, a second canopied block at right, a paved forecourt with a curved low planter holding a shrub, and a white multi-storey hotel with balconies behind.

IMG_2625.jpg.title: Paseo looking south-west beside the sandstone wall and glazed building
IMG_2625.jpg.observation: Pink stamped paving with two walkers and a slim white lamp post beside a sandstone wall topped by chain-link fence; behind it grass and a single-storey building with a deep flat canopy and dark glazing, and olive trees; white Villacana walls appear in the far distance on the left.

IMG_2626.jpg.title: Side of disused glazed building and forecourt with a three-storey hotel behind
IMG_2626.jpg.observation: Chain link, a grass verge and sandstone wall in front of a long flat-canopied glazed building at left; a paved forecourt with a low whitewashed planter holding shrubs leads to a white three-storey hotel with balconies and bougainvillea.

IMG_2627.jpg.title: White single-storey cottage with green plinth and flagstone path behind chain link
IMG_2627.jpg.observation: A white rendered single-storey building with dark green base, a terracotta-tile eave, hanging pots on its wall and a green door stands on a lawn with a flagstone path and a leaning bare tree trunk; a three-storey white hotel with balcony rises behind trees.

IMG_2628.jpg.title: Paseo far north-east of Barraka towards lamp posts and palms
IMG_2628.jpg.observation: A straight pink paseo with a timber edge beside the beach, a chain-link fence and grass at left with a white cottage, slim lamp posts, palms and low white buildings, the shoreline and mountains in the distance.

IMG_2630.jpg.title: Barraka's glazed north-west frontage with sandbags along the slot drain
IMG_2630.jpg.observation: Looking south-west along the paseo: Barraka's timber-framed glazed wall with frosted 'BARRAKA BEACH' lettering, an ice-cream poster and a scalloped maroon awning at left; sandbags on black sheeting along a slot drain; at right a sandstone-faced wall with green bar fence, lawn, white houses and palms; the pink paseo curves away.

IMG_2631.jpg.title: Looking south-south-west from Barraka's awning across the roped lounge garden and paseo
IMG_2631.jpg.observation: A maroon scalloped awning at top left; the pink stamped paseo with a black slot drain curves away to the right of a grass lounge area enclosed by a rope on timber posts with rattan armchairs, a closed parasol, a menu stand on an iron base, an easel and terracotta pots; a white pergola, scrub and the sea beyond.

IMG_2632.jpg.title: West paseo curving south-west under the sandstone wall
IMG_2632.jpg.observation: Pink stamped paving curves along a yellow sandstone retaining wall topped by green cloth-covered mesh fence and hedge with white houses and a palm above; slim white lamp posts line the wall and a dry sandy verge with agaves and a timber edge falls to the beach on the left.

IMG_2633.jpg.title: West paseo bend with agave verge and timber edge
IMG_2633.jpg.observation: A pink stamped-concrete walkway with a timber kerb bends away to the south-west beside a dry sand verge with agaves and low scrub; the pebble beach and sea lie beyond under a pale sky.

IMG_2634.jpg.title: West paseo with agave verge, sandstone wall and white house in the distance
IMG_2634.jpg.observation: The pink paseo with timber edge curves left past a sandy verge with young agaves and scrub; the sandstone wall with green mesh fence and a lamp post on the right, palms and a white tile-roofed house in the distance, the sea at left.

IMG_2635.jpg.title: White seafront houses seen over the south-pool sandstone wall, fence and hedge
IMG_2635.jpg.observation: A yellow rough-cut sandstone wall topped by a green rigid-mesh fence and clipped hedge in the foreground, with white two-storey houses behind: brown shutters and doors, wrought-iron balconies, an arched entrance, tile roof edges, lamps and low hedges at their base.

IMG_2636.jpg.title: Paseo and sandstone wall with green shade cloth near Calle Pintor Dali
IMG_2636.jpg.observation: The pink paseo runs south-west beside a sandstone wall carrying a green cloth-covered mesh fence with a palm above; a white lamp post, a flush floor light and a bin stand beside a dry sandy slope with reeds, and a cyclist rides ahead.

IMG_2637.jpg.title: Paseo end by the Calle Pintor Dali car park with hedge behind mesh fence
IMG_2637.jpg.observation: Pink paving beside a sandstone wall topped by a green mesh fence and clipped hedge; ahead a gravel track with a white van, reeds and a lamp post where the paseo meets the car park side, with a service cover set in the paving.

IMG_2638.jpg.title: Paseo wall end and kerbed junction near Dali car park
IMG_2638.jpg.observation: Pink stamped paving with a drain cover and flush light beside a yellow sandstone wall that steps down to the junction; the green mesh fence and hedge stand on top, a white van and a gravel area lie beyond a small raised kerb at the top left.

IMG_2639.jpg.title: Vaulted arcade with patterned tile floor, pebble mosaic and garden gate beyond
IMG_2639.jpg.observation: Looking ENE along a white vaulted arcade: terracotta floor with blue-and-white inset tiles in an offset pattern and a rectangular grey-and-black pebble mosaic panel; dark brown double door on the right, a hanging black lantern, white curved planters with strappy plants, and a bougainvillea-draped arch ahead with an open black iron gate and lawn beyond.

IMG_2640.jpg.title: Bougainvillea over a white arch, second arch and gate beyond, pebble mosaic floor panel
IMG_2640.jpg.observation: Large bougainvillea trained across a white round arch; a smaller arch beyond leads to a tiled passage ending in an open black iron gate and lawn. White walls with brown doors, an intercom panel, a house-number plate, an upper balcony with black iron rail and shutters, a starburst pebble mosaic panel and drain grille in the foreground, planters with shrubs.

IMG_2641.jpg.title: Passage to the south pool lawn: arched iron gate and Calle de Jorge plaque
IMG_2641.jpg.observation: Terracotta-tiled passage with blue-and-white inserts between white walls, white planters with clipped shrubs on both sides, and a round-arched black iron gate standing open onto crazy paving and lawn. A black-and-white tile plaque on the right wall reads CALLE DE JORGE with two house numbers (not fully legible).

IMG_2642.jpg.title: Open iron gate onto crazy-paving path and south pool lawn
IMG_2642.jpg.observation: Standing at an open black iron gate: stone crazy-paving path between two clipped hedges with white curved kerbs leads to a lawn. A glass-fenced pool edge with a lifebuoy, a white two-storey house with brown shutters and a tiled roof, a tall candelabra cactus and a palm with sea beyond are visible ahead.

IMG_2643.jpg.title: South lawn towards the east houses: candelabra cactus, palms and paseo fence
IMG_2643.jpg.observation: Wide mown lawn sloping gently; white two-storey house with a round tower, tiled roof and outside stair rail at left; two tall candelabra euphorbia cacti, clipped hedges, a small group of palms, a blue sign, lamp posts and the paseo mesh fence with the sea and distant hills behind. A low bollard light on the lawn.

IMG_2644.jpg.title: South lawn seaward edge: hedges, palms and mesh fence above the paseo
IMG_2644.jpg.observation: Lawn runs along a clipped hedge and shrub bed beside a green mesh fence with tall white lamp posts; bollard light and flush covers in the grass. A white house with a round tiled turret and shuttered arched windows stands at left, palms and a blue sign near the fence, beach, coast and mountains beyond.

IMG_2646.jpg.title: Calle Silvia lane looking NNW to an arched iron gate
IMG_2646.jpg.observation: Narrow terracotta-tiled lane between high white walls: white curved planter wall with lantana and shrubs on the left, a barred ground-floor window on the right, and ahead a white arch with open black gate leaves and bougainvillea trailing across its top.

IMG_2647.jpg.title: Lane arch with open iron gate leaves, terracotta paving with wide grout
IMG_2647.jpg.observation: Closer to the arch: square terracotta tiles about the width of a walking step with broad grey grout, a long raised white planter with climbers on the left, a plain white wall on the right, and an arch with black gate leaves, lantern and bougainvillea; the lane continues beyond between white houses.

IMG_2648.jpg.title: White cubic houses behind an oleander hedge, east of Calle Silvia
IMG_2648.jpg.observation: Looking NNE over an oleander hedge: two-storey rendered white houses with flat roofs, stepped blocks, a window with an iron balcony rail, bougainvillea on a terrace wall and a clipped hedge; lawn and stone stepping path in front of the ground floor.

IMG_2649.jpg.title: House fronts behind oleander and green netting beside the lane
IMG_2649.jpg.observation: Two-storey white houses with chimney-like tower, balcony with black iron rail, French windows, wall lanterns and small blue tile plaque; oleander hedge fronted by dark green shade netting on a lawn, terracotta lane paving with a pale concrete edge strip at left.

IMG_2650.jpg.title: Looking back SSE down the lane to a gate onto the south pool lawn
IMG_2650.jpg.observation: Arched white gateway with two open black iron gate leaves and a barred window on the right; beyond it a lawn, a glass pool fence with a lifebuoy and a blue sign. Terracotta lane paving with a raised white planter on the right and oleander on the left; notice and blue mandatory-sign plates on the wall by the gate.

IMG_2651.jpg.title: Terracotta lane beside oleander hedge, houses with bougainvillea to the east
IMG_2651.jpg.observation: Terracotta slab path bordered on the left by an oleander hedge screened by green netting; white house facade with bougainvillea, a barred balcony at left, a meter cabinet, wall lantern, a tall clipped climber-covered bush and garden furniture beyond.

IMG_2652.jpg.title: Lawn and patio at a white house corner with air conditioner
IMG_2652.jpg.observation: Looking east across oleanders to a lawn, a clipped hibiscus hedge, a stone stepping path to a terracotta patio, and a white rendered corner with balcony rail, doorway and a wall-mounted air-conditioning unit.

IMG_2653.jpg.title: House front with balcony and bougainvillea behind oleander and netting
IMG_2653.jpg.observation: White house facade with an iron balcony rail, recessed ground-floor door with canopy, bougainvillea, meter cabinet and a yellow rose in front; oleander and green netting along the lane, with terracotta paving at the lower right.

IMG_2654.jpg.title: Terracotta lane paving close-up with aggregate edging and cross band
IMG_2654.jpg.observation: Looking down at square terracotta slabs with pale grout, a granite-aggregate edge strip along the planting bed and a cross band of the same aggregate; one cracked slab, soil bed with oleander and green netting.

IMG_2656.jpg.title: Silvia 22-44 covered passage: red studded ramp and three tiled steps
IMG_2656.jpg.observation: Looking WSW into a covered passage with a flat white ceiling, two hanging black lanterns, paired dark brown doors each side, and an arch ahead onto a planted garden path. A red-brown studded rubber ramp occupies the left of the floor beside three terracotta steps with white nosings and blue-and-white inset tiles; white planters with succulents line the left. Tile plaque 22 44 CALLE DE SILVIA at left.

IMG_2657.jpg.title: Silvia 22-44 passage: steps with dark edge bands beside studded ramp
IMG_2657.jpg.observation: Same passage from slightly lower: three terracotta steps with white risers and dark blue-grey border lines beside a red studded rubber ramp, white planter walls with shrubs, brown doors, lantern, a doormat and the arched exit with bougainvillea and flowering garden beyond.

IMG_2660.jpg.title: Narrow lane between white walls and a barred house front, heading NNW
IMG_2660.jpg.observation: Terracotta slab lane squeezed between a high plain white wall with a roller awning on the right and a house front with black iron window grilles and a white planter on the left; at the far end white walls, a shuttered arched window and a palm.

IMG_2661.jpg.title: Pavement at the Silvia / Patricia junction: slab, covers and white wall
IMG_2661.jpg.observation: Close view of terracotta paving with pale aggregate borders and a corner join, a concrete service slab, a red-brown ribbed cover, a white wall with hairline cracks and a brown door, and the end of a white planter with shrubs.

IMG_2662.jpg.title: Calle Patricia lane looking WSW between white walls with brown doors
IMG_2662.jpg.observation: Long straight terracotta lane lined by high white garden walls with brown arched doors under bougainvillea on the right, hedges and yellow-green shrubs on white-kerbed beds on the left, a shopping trolley against the wall, trees at the far end.

IMG_2663.jpg.title: Calle Patricia lane looking ENE: white wall with brown door, bougainvillea and defibrillator sign
IMG_2663.jpg.observation: Walled frontage with an arched brown wooden door under flowering bougainvillea, a green defibrillator sign, a house-number tile, stepped white wall copings, a concrete slab with drain grille and pavers; terracotta paving runs away to the right with a ribbed cover.

IMG_2664.jpg.title: Calle Silvia north: tiled lane looking NNW to the arch and lawn
IMG_2664.jpg.observation: Straight terracotta lane with white planter walls and clipped shrubs, white houses with shutters and bougainvillea on the right, a left-hand white wall stepped with a terracotta cap, a red ribbed cover in the paving and a white arch at the far end showing a lawn and palm.

IMG_2665.jpg.title: Barred shuttered window and arched openings on Calle Silvia north
IMG_2665.jpg.observation: Cream-white facade with a projecting black iron grille over brown louvred shutters on a terracotta sill, a wall lantern with bougainvillea, arched recesses and a stepped cornice; agapanthus-like plants in a bed on the right and the lane running to a white gate arch.

IMG_2666.jpg.title: Calle Silvia north: arched recesses either side, gate arch with green lattice ahead
IMG_2666.jpg.observation: Lane of terracotta slabs with arched cream recesses and wall lanterns on both sides, a black grille and climbers on the left, a raised planter and strappy plants on the right, and a white gate arch with a green lattice at the far end opening to lawn.

IMG_2667.jpg.title: Recessed arched entrance with door, pots and inlaid tile floor
IMG_2667.jpg.observation: Camera under a round arch looking into a covered recess: brown door on the back wall, two large potted schefflera, a floor of terracotta with scattered blue-and-white inset tiles, an electrical cabinet low on the left wall and plain red ribbed cover at the lower left.

IMG_2668.jpg.title: Silvia passage interior looking ENE to the arch
IMG_2668.jpg.observation: Covered passage with arched white ceiling, hanging lantern, paired brown doors on both sides, two large pots of schefflera and an arch at the end opening onto a planted path; floor is terracotta with a dense scatter of blue-and-white inserts and a doormat.

IMG_2669.jpg.title: Silvia 2-20 passage: red studded ramp, three steps and garden gate arch
IMG_2669.jpg.observation: Looking WSW through a covered passage: red studded rubber ramp at left with a square access cover, three white-nosed terracotta steps at right with pale grout, brown double doors each side, potted plants and a flower box, and a round arch with iron gate and bougainvillea beyond. House numbers 2 and 20 on the left wall.

IMG_2670.jpg.title: Silvia 2-20 passage: plaque, ramp, steps and arched gate
IMG_2670.jpg.observation: Same passage slightly wider: plaque reading SILVIA 2 20 on the left wall, lantern hanging from the flat ceiling, brown doors, pots with red flowers, a red studded ramp with square cover beside three terracotta steps with white nosings, and an arch with gate and garden ahead.

IMG_2671.jpg.title: Silvia lane north of the tunnel looking NW to the middle pool south gateway
IMG_2671.jpg.observation: Square terracotta lane with grey grout runs between a white house wall (green barred windows, climbing bougainvillea, low white planter walls with tile caps) and dense planting on the right. An arched white gateway with dark green gate leaves stands at the far end with lawn and a palm beyond.

IMG_2672.jpg.title: Covered arched passage under the east block, looking east into a garden
IMG_2672.jpg.observation: A white vaulted passage with a hanging lantern, recessed shuttered windows and two potted shrubs frames a round arch opening onto a planted garden path. The floor is square terracotta with small blue/cream insert tiles and a pebble-mosaic rectangle in the foreground.

IMG_2673.jpg.title: Courtyard path inside the east block with raised planters and a manhole
IMG_2673.jpg.observation: Wide terracotta path with a stepped diagonal pattern of blue/cream insert tiles runs between cream-edged raised planters full of shrubs; an iron manhole cover is in the lower-left and the path curves away between hedges to white walls and a kerbed bend.

IMG_2674.jpg.title: Second arched opening inside the east block with lantern and potted ficus
IMG_2674.jpg.observation: A white arch with climbing bougainvillea frames two large potted ficus trees, a hanging lantern, a doormat and, further on, a second arch opening to a garden with a patio umbrella. The floor is terracotta with blue/cream insert tiles in a stepped pattern and a cream-edged bed at the lower left.

IMG_2676.jpg.title: Terracotta path between hedge and lawn at the Teodoro Rojo end of Calle Eva
IMG_2676.jpg.observation: Wide square-tile terracotta path with light grout edges runs SW between a clipped hedge/white low wall on the left and a lawn bordered by a white rendered kerb on the right; a drain/manhole cover is in the lower right corner and a white wall and hedges close the far end.

IMG_2677.jpg.title: Calle Eva path to the middle pool east gateway with bougainvillea and house beyond
IMG_2677.jpg.observation: A terracotta path with a white low planter wall on the left and lawn on the right leads to an arched white gateway with open dark green iron gates, wall signs, clipped hedges and pink bougainvillea. A two-storey white house with a tiled balcony and a palm stand behind; a brown door is at right.

IMG_2678.jpg.title: Looking through the middle pool east gateway at the pool and houses beyond
IMG_2678.jpg.observation: Taken in the gateway under the curved white wall cap with one dark green iron gate leaf open. A flagstone and terracotta entry with two drain covers leads past clipped hedges to a pool edge with a glass safety fence and steps, with two white houses with brown doors and shutters, a banana plant and a lifebuoy behind.

IMG_2679.jpg.title: Middle pool lawn with crazy-paving path and glass-fenced pool, looking west
IMG_2679.jpg.observation: A flagstone path curves between lawn with a bollard light and a white curved low wall topped with clipped hedge. On the left is the pool with steps, handrails and a glass safety fence; across it stand white two-storey houses with a tiled balcony roof, brown shutters, umbrellas, a palm and a large feathery tree.

IMG_2680.jpg.title: Middle pool west lawn: crazy-paving path, white curved wall and house frontage
IMG_2680.jpg.observation: A flagstone path with an offshoot slope crosses lawn beside a white low wall with a clipped hedge and orange-flowered bed; behind are white houses with brown arched doors, a balcony with brown shutters, an umbrella and a dark iron gate at right.

IMG_2681.jpg.title: West gate between Calle Elena and the middle pool lawn
IMG_2681.jpg.observation: A flagstone path runs beside a curved white wall with a thick glossy hedge; ahead a dark green iron gate stands open in a white wall beside a brown timber door, with a tree, bed of orange flowers and a striped umbrella behind. Two-storey white house walls with arched windows rise behind.

IMG_2682.jpg.title: Calle Elena south lane looking NNW with door steps and barred gate
IMG_2682.jpg.observation: A narrow terracotta lane with grey grout lines runs between a white wall with brown doors and raised tiled doorsteps on the left and a white wall with a dark iron-barred gate/window, climbing plants, a lantern and succulent beds on the right; a lawn and bougainvillea show at the far end.

IMG_2683.jpg.title: Calle Elena south: lawn with clipped trees beside the lane, bougainvillea houses
IMG_2683.jpg.observation: A terracotta lane with a cream kerb curve borders lawn with a clipped mushroom-shaped tree and lantana at lower left. White garden walls with brown timber doors, bougainvillea and balconied houses with a tiled eave stand behind.

IMG_2684.jpg.title: Calle Elena south: lane between clipped-tree lawns toward balconied houses
IMG_2684.jpg.observation: Terracotta lane runs NW with cream-kerbed lawn beds on the left holding mushroom-shaped clipped trees and a cross-path of red tiles. White houses with a tiled balcony roof, brown shutters, doors and bougainvillea close the view; a street lantern and white wall are at right.

IMG_2685.jpg.title: Calle Elena looking north: barred wall frontage and lawn bed
IMG_2685.jpg.observation: Terracotta lane with a cream kerb on the left (lawn with a manhole cover) and a right-hand wall of white render with dark iron bars over windows, tile-capped sills, silver-leaf bedding and a lamp post. A balconied house with a tiled eave and bougainvillea closes the end.

IMG_2686.jpg.title: Calle Elena north from the Cervantes junction: hedged beds and white walls
IMG_2686.jpg.observation: A terracotta lane with straight grout lines runs north between white house walls with barred green windows and climbers on the left and clipped hedge-edged beds with pollarded trees, shrubs and drip pipes on the right. Far on, a white garden wall with a shuttered window and an arched gate close the view.

IMG_2688.jpg.title: Calle Elena north: arched recessed entrance and lantern, lane to the north pool gateway
IMG_2688.jpg.observation: A white wall with a large arch recessing a doorway (red tile step, number plate) and a black iron lantern on a bracket stands left of a terracotta lane. Further on are dark iron gate/bars, a lamp, an open white arched gateway with lawn beyond, and clipped planting along the right.

IMG_2689.jpg.title: Calle Elena covered passage: steps and studded ramp under the sign Calle Elena 18-36
IMG_2689.jpg.observation: Inside a white covered walkway a wall carries black tile lettering reading CALLE ELENA 18 36 and a small plaque CASA WILKES beside a dark brown door. The terracotta floor with blue/cream inserts rises by three whitewashed steps beside a red studded rubber ramp, with a meter box on the wall.

IMG_2690.jpg.title: Elena covered walkway looking WSW to the paired iron gates
IMG_2690.jpg.observation: A white barrel passage with a hanging lantern has a tall brown panelled door on the left and a pebble-mosaic rectangle set in square terracotta paving with blue/cream insert tiles. Two clipped potted shrubs and open dark gates with a garden beyond lie at the end under a round arch.

IMG_2691.jpg.title: Brown double door with warning sign in the Elena covered walkway
IMG_2691.jpg.observation: A close view of a brown panelled double door with brass knobs and a yellow high-voltage triangle, set in a white recess; the floor outside is terracotta with blue-edged insert tiles and a small window niche is at right.

IMG_2692.jpg.title: Arched brown entrance door with iron grille and doormat
IMG_2692.jpg.observation: A single arched-top brown panelled door with a small square iron grille, brass round knob and an intercom beside it, in a white recess; a coir doormat with blue/red pattern lies on terracotta.

IMG_2725.jpg.title: Barred gate view into a laundry corridor with a red studded ramp
IMG_2725.jpg.observation: Through a white-painted iron gate a corridor leads away with a red studded rubber ramp, a green handrail, a bilingual sign LAVANDERIA - LIMPIEZA - LAUNDRY - CLEANING, a notice board and glazed doors; daylight and planting show at the far end.

IMG_2771.jpg.title: Seaward lane with tall white wall and lantana, looking NW
IMG_2771.jpg.observation: A terracotta lane with a slot drain across it runs between a white house wall at left (small window, lamp post ahead) and a long white wall on the right topped with orange lantana; curved-roof white buildings with blue signs and a banana plant show at the far end.

IMG_2813.jpg.title: Brown door with iron grille and doormat, close view
IMG_2813.jpg.observation: A brown panelled door with a small square iron grille above a brass knob and lock, a coir mat with a red motif on terracotta tiles, and a white arched recess; a switch panel is at the top-left.

IMG_2822.jpg.title: Seaward lane descending between white curved walls to the sea fence
IMG_2822.jpg.observation: A terracotta lane runs down between white rendered walls (left planter wall with lantana, right curved wall with a pier) with a slot drain across the lane, a cast manhole cover and a metal drain grate. Paving changes from rectangular tiles to octagonal terracotta with infill; a hedge and dark metal fence stand at the lane end with the sea beyond.

IMG_2655.jpg.title: Red studded ramp beside tiled steps at a passage mouth
IMG_2655.jpg.observation: A red studded rubber ramp runs beside three terracotta-tread steps with white risers up to a white entrance with a low planter of clipped shrubs; square terracotta lane tiles in front.

IMG_2659.jpg.title: Narrow tiled lane between a raised planter and a green-screened wall
IMG_2659.jpg.observation: Square terracotta tiles with a service cover run up a narrow lane between a white kerbed planter of yellow-variegated shrubs and green-meshed garden fencing with oleander; barred windows on the left.

IMG_2696.jpg.title: Crazy-paving path from the Dali parking into a garden lane
IMG_2696.jpg.observation: A crazy-paving path with white kerb edges leaves the asphalt between parked cars, running between lawns to houses with purple bougainvillea, a lantern post and clipped round trees.

IMG_2697.jpg.title: Crazy-paving path from the Dali parking, wider view
IMG_2697.jpg.observation: The same crazy-paving path between parked cars with white kerbs, lawns either side, lantern post, clipped round trees and bougainvillea on the house fronts.

IMG_2698.jpg.title: Crazy-paving path and lantern beyond parked cars
IMG_2698.jpg.observation: Closer view of the crazy-paving path with a white-kerbed mouth at the asphalt, a black lantern on a green post, lawns and bougainvillea on the houses beyond.

IMG_2699.jpg.title: Dali car park aisle with marked bays, looking north
IMG_2699.jpg.observation: Asphalt aisle with white bay lines and a white kerb, tall hedges and trees on the left, house frontages with balconies on the right.

IMG_2700.jpg.title: Dali car park aisle with white kerbs and frontage planters
IMG_2700.jpg.observation: Asphalt aisle with bay lines, a kerbed hedge planter and climbers in front of white garden walls, a tall hedge and trees on the left.

IMG_2701.jpg.title: Small tiled forecourt at the Dali kerb with a lantern
IMG_2701.jpg.observation: A square-tiled apron edged by a white kerb meets the asphalt by a parked car; a lantern post, a clipped tree and a white house with bougainvillea and a balcony behind.

IMG_2702.jpg.title: Narrow lane between walls with a street plaque and slot drain
IMG_2702.jpg.observation: A square-tiled lane with a rusty slot drain runs between white garden walls with bougainvillea and a brown door; a tiled street plaque on the left wall.

IMG_2703.jpg.title: Eva west footpath beside the Dali road, looking north
IMG_2703.jpg.observation: The tiled footpath runs between a kerbed grass strip on the road side and a kerbed planted bed under the house walls with bougainvillea; parked cars on the road.

IMG_2704.jpg.title: Eva west footpath with kerbed grass strip, looking north
IMG_2704.jpg.observation: Four-tile path with white kerbs both sides, grass strip and road on the left, planted bed and barred windows on the right, lantern and van ahead.

IMG_2705.jpg.title: Eva west end: lawn island with strelitzia and the curving path
IMG_2705.jpg.observation: The tiled path curves round a kerbed lawn island with a big strelitzia, utility covers and a yellow-capped bollard; low-hedged bed with soil on the right, white houses behind.

IMG_2706.jpg.title: Eva west stretch from the Dali end, looking north-east
IMG_2706.jpg.observation: Four-tile lane between a kerbed lawn with a yellow-capped bollard on the left and a deep kerbed bed with low hedge edging and roses on the right; house fronts with brown doors.

IMG_2707.jpg.title: Eva west stretch: kerbed rose bed and house fronts
IMG_2707.jpg.observation: Tiled lane beside a long kerbed bed with low box edging and roses in bare soil, in front of white walls with a brown gate and clipped cypress; bougainvillea arch ahead.

IMG_2708.jpg.title: Eva west stretch towards the middle pool gate, slot drain
IMG_2708.jpg.observation: Square tiles with a rust-red slot drain run between a white wall with a tiled house-number plaque and a brown door, and barred windows with bougainvillea; the pool gateway with notices at the end.

IMG_2710.jpg.title: Middle pool south-west gate at the end of Calle Eva west
IMG_2710.jpg.observation: An open iron gate in a white wall under a bougainvillea arch, with notice boards, leads from the tiled lane into the pool garden; brown door on the right.

IMG_2711.jpg.title: Through the gate: tiled path into the middle pool garden
IMG_2711.jpg.observation: Square tiles between a white kerb with grey aggregate and a hedge lead towards the glass-fenced middle pool, strelitzia and pollarded trees.

IMG_2712.jpg.title: Where the terracotta path meets the crazy paving
IMG_2712.jpg.observation: Large square terracotta tiles with a grey aggregate edge butt against crazy paving at the lawn of the middle pool garden; white kerbed planter on the left.

IMG_2713.jpg.title: Crazy-paving path round the glass-fenced middle pool
IMG_2713.jpg.observation: Crazy paving follows a curved white planter wall with a hedge on top round the glass-fenced pool deck; houses with bougainvillea beyond.

IMG_2714.jpg.title: Crazy-paving fork and lawn wedge beside the pool fence
IMG_2714.jpg.observation: Crazy-paving paths fork around triangular lawns beside the glass pool fence; a hedge on a white kerb wall behind.

IMG_2715.jpg.title: Crazy-paving path to an arched gateway, hedged lawn
IMG_2715.jpg.observation: A crazy-paving path curves past a hedged white planter and a lawn to a white arched gateway with a lantern and brown door.

IMG_2721.jpg.title: Narrow seaward lane with barred windows and tile sills
IMG_2721.jpg.observation: A square-tiled lane between a plain white wall and house fronts with tall green window grilles over terracotta sills and bougainvillea; lantern ahead.

IMG_2723.jpg.title: Espaliered bougainvillea and window grille in a seaward lane
IMG_2723.jpg.observation: Bougainvillea trained flat on a white wall above a white planter beside a tall green ironwork grille; tiled lane continues.

IMG_2724.jpg.title: Espaliered bougainvillea over a white planter
IMG_2724.jpg.observation: A woody bougainvillea trained across a white wall from a square white planter, the lane running on past barred windows.

IMG_2727.jpg.title: Calle Eva east: octagonal paving, lantern and tiled bench
IMG_2727.jpg.observation: Octagonal terracotta paving with small square inserts, manholes and drains; a lantern post on a lawn, a white rendered bench, hedged white planters and bougainvillea, looking west along Eva.

IMG_2728.jpg.title: Side garden with brick-edged steps off Calle Eva east
IMG_2728.jpg.observation: Terracotta tiles with brick-on-edge step nosings lead to a walled lawn strip between white planters with hedges and a gate at the end.

IMG_2729.jpg.title: Side garden with brick-edged steps, wider view
IMG_2729.jpg.observation: The same brick-nosed steps and walled lawn strip off Eva, hedged planters either side, tree and bougainvillea above.

IMG_2730.jpg.title: White rendered bench with an azulejo panel on Calle Eva east
IMG_2730.jpg.observation: A white rendered bench with a curved back and a blue-and-yellow tile panel stands on octagonal paving beside a drain grate and a manhole, with a hedged planter behind.

IMG_2732.jpg.title: Calle Eva east: bench, lantern and octagonal paving
IMG_2732.jpg.observation: Looking west along Eva: a white azulejo bench, lantern post, hedged white planters and the octagonal-tiled lane with cast covers.

IMG_2759.jpg.title: Lawn path to a white gateway towards the sea
IMG_2759.jpg.observation: A pink stamped-concrete path crosses a large lawn with bollard lights to an arched white gateway in a wall; the sea fence beyond.

IMG_2760.jpg.title: Large lawn towards the Barraka building
IMG_2760.jpg.observation: A big lawn with an inspection cover, bollard light and pink path edge; the Barraka building, palms and lamp posts beyond a hedge.

IMG_2761.jpg.title: Lawn and pink path towards the seafront railing
IMG_2761.jpg.observation: Pink stamped path along a lawn with bollard lights to the seafront railings, palms and a lamp post.

IMG_2762.jpg.title: Strelitzia in a white walled corner on the lawn
IMG_2762.jpg.observation: A large strelitzia and grey-leaved shrubs in a bed against a white walled outbuilding beside the lawn.

IMG_2763.jpg.title: Pink path curving round a white wall to the sea fence
IMG_2763.jpg.observation: The pink stamped path curves past a rounded white wall and a hedge to the mesh sea fence and a lamp post.

IMG_2764.jpg.title: Main pool lawn and the wave-roofed building
IMG_2764.jpg.observation: A pink path runs across the lawn with bollard lights and a bin to the main pool and the white wave-roofed building; tall palms.

IMG_2765.jpg.title: Main pool lawn and wave-roofed building, second view
IMG_2765.jpg.observation: The same lawn, pink path and bollards towards the pool, the wave-roofed building and palms.

IMG_2766.jpg.title: Painted crossing and blue plumbago at a gated wall
IMG_2766.jpg.observation: A red-and-white painted crossing on the stamped paseo surface in front of a white arched gate with plumbago and a green railing.

IMG_2767.jpg.title: Painted crossing at the gated wall, looking south-west
IMG_2767.jpg.observation: The painted crossing, plumbago-covered white gate piers, green railing and the paseo curving to the beach.

IMG_2769.jpg.title: Paseo towards Barraka beside the railing
IMG_2769.jpg.observation: The stamped paseo runs beside a green railing on a sandstone base towards Barraka; lamp post and rough grass verge.

IMG_2770.jpg.title: Paseo edge and grass verge towards Barraka
IMG_2770.jpg.observation: The stamped paseo edge beside a sandy grass verge with Barraka, palms and parasols beyond.

IMG_2773.jpg.title: Lane beside the main pool with a lantana planter wall
IMG_2773.jpg.observation: Square terracotta tiles beside a long white planter wall topped with yellow lantana and a palm; the pool and wave-roofed building to the right, lawn on the left.

IMG_2774.jpg.title: Octagonal-paved lane beside the lantana planter
IMG_2774.jpg.observation: Octagonal terracotta paving runs downhill beside the white lantana planter wall to the pool building; pool on the right.

IMG_2775.jpg.title: Lane down to the pool building with slot drains
IMG_2775.jpg.observation: The lane steps down beside the planter wall, with rust slot drains across it, to steps and a ramp at the wave-roofed shops.

IMG_2776.jpg.title: Steps and ramp at the foot of the lane by the pool building
IMG_2776.jpg.observation: Tiled steps with a handrail and a ramp beside the planter wall at the shops, with a drain across the lane.

IMG_2777.jpg.title: Marble-edged steps down to the main pool deck
IMG_2777.jpg.observation: Steps with white marble nosings and blue tile risers lead down beside a white wall with a black handrail to the main pool deck and lawn.

IMG_2778.jpg.title: Strelitzias and clipped hedge at a lane plaque
IMG_2778.jpg.observation: Tall strelitzias, a clipped hedge and grey-leaved shrubs in a lawn garden beside an octagonal path; a tiled street plaque on a low wall.

IMG_2779.jpg.title: Strelitzia clump and clipped shrubs on a lawn
IMG_2779.jpg.observation: A big strelitzia clump with grey edging plants and clipped shrubs on a lawn in front of houses.

IMG_2780.jpg.title: Private lawn and patio of a corner house
IMG_2780.jpg.observation: A lawn with garden furniture in front of a white house with a climbing shrub and a strelitzia.

IMG_2781.jpg.title: Narrow lane with espaliered bougainvillea and a wall lantern
IMG_2781.jpg.observation: A square-tiled lane between white walls, bougainvillea trained on the right wall from a planter, wall lantern on the left.

IMG_2782.jpg.title: Espaliered bougainvillea over a planter, close
IMG_2782.jpg.observation: Close view of the bougainvillea trained across a white wall from its square planter beside a barred window.

IMG_2783.jpg.title: Narrow lane with wall lantern and planters, looking north
IMG_2783.jpg.observation: The tiled lane continues between white walls with a wrought-iron wall lantern and planters, a person further along.

IMG_2784.jpg.title: Tiled lane with drain beside a raised planter
IMG_2784.jpg.observation: Square terracotta tiles with a slot drain beside a raised white planter with a hedge and a doorstep.

IMG_2785.jpg.title: Calle Eva east: octagonal paving between hedged planters
IMG_2785.jpg.observation: Octagonal paving with covers runs between a long hedged white planter and a house wall, towards a strelitzia, lantern and houses.

IMG_2786.jpg.title: Eva east: strelitzia, azulejo bench and lantern
IMG_2786.jpg.observation: A white rendered bench with a tile panel on a lawn beside a large strelitzia, hedge and lantern; bougainvillea over the houses.

IMG_2787.jpg.title: Eva east: strelitzia and azulejo bench, closer
IMG_2787.jpg.observation: Strelitzia clump, white tiled bench and lantern on the lawn beside the tiled lane.

IMG_2788.jpg.title: Eva east looking west: square tiles between hedged planters
IMG_2788.jpg.observation: Square terracotta tiles with an aggregate edge between hedged white planters, lantern and a house with brown shutters ahead.

IMG_2789.jpg.title: Eva tiled lane beside a hedge planter
IMG_2789.jpg.observation: Large square tiles with grey aggregate margins between a hedged white planter and a white wall.

IMG_2790.jpg.title: Eva tiled lane with hedge planter and bougainvillea
IMG_2790.jpg.observation: The square-tiled lane between hedged planters and a white wall with bougainvillea, pollarded tree ahead.

IMG_2791.jpg.title: Tiled lane with grille windows and a raised planter
IMG_2791.jpg.observation: Square tiles with covers between barred windows and a raised white planter with hedge, a pollarded tree beside the lane.

IMG_2792.jpg.title: Passage mouth with a CALLE ALBERTO 22-40 sign
IMG_2792.jpg.observation: A covered entrance with a tiled CALLE ALBERTO 22 40 sign, a potted plant, red studded floor and a step.

IMG_2794.jpg.title: Lane with bougainvillea and grille windows, looking south-west
IMG_2794.jpg.observation: A square-tiled lane between a white wall and house fronts with green grilles and bougainvillea.

IMG_2795.jpg.title: Lane between a white wall and flowering shrubs
IMG_2795.jpg.observation: Square tiles between a white wall with a door and beds of lantana, red-leaved shrubs and bougainvillea.

IMG_2796.jpg.title: Lane beside a brown door and flowering beds
IMG_2796.jpg.observation: The tiled lane passes a brown door in a white wall, with a dense bed of lantana and red shrubs on the right.

IMG_2797.jpg.title: Lane through flowering beds towards a white wall
IMG_2797.jpg.observation: Square tiles run between a white planter wall with red-leaved shrubs and lantana beds, bougainvillea beyond.

IMG_2798.jpg.title: Lane between flowering hedges, looking south-west
IMG_2798.jpg.observation: Square tiles between a red-flowered hedge on the left and a white-flowered shrub bed on the right, bougainvillea and houses ahead.

IMG_2799.jpg.title: Lane with a kerbed bed and a CALLE plaque ahead
IMG_2799.jpg.observation: Square tiles beside a kerbed hedged bed, a white wall with bougainvillea and a tiled street plaque ahead.

IMG_2800.jpg.title: Fan palm bed and street plaque at a lane corner
IMG_2800.jpg.observation: A kerbed bed with fan palms and low hedge at a lane corner below a white wall with a tiled street plaque and bougainvillea.

IMG_2801.jpg.title: Lane between a raised planter and a rose bed
IMG_2801.jpg.observation: Square tiles between a white raised planter with palms and a long low-hedged rose bed, lantern ahead.

IMG_2802.jpg.title: Calle Elena north: lane past hedged beds and trees
IMG_2802.jpg.observation: Square tiles between barred house fronts and kerbed beds with low hedges and pollarded trees, a white wall with a grille window ahead.

IMG_2803.jpg.title: Calle Elena north: lane with low hedge beds
IMG_2803.jpg.observation: The tiled lane between kerbed low-hedge beds and grilled house fronts, magnolia-like trees and a white grille wall ahead.

IMG_2804.jpg.title: Calle Elena north: lane with spider-plant beds
IMG_2804.jpg.observation: Square tiles between house fronts with lanterns and a bed of spider plants and shrubs, white walls with grille windows ahead.

IMG_2805.jpg.title: Calle Elena north: arched porch beside the lane
IMG_2805.jpg.observation: The tiled lane passes an arched porch with a lantern and a red step, bougainvillea and a white grille wall ahead.

IMG_2806.jpg.title: CALLE ELENA 18 36 plaque at the covered walkway mouth
IMG_2806.jpg.observation: A tiled CALLE ELENA 18 36 plaque inside an arched entrance with red-tiled steps, the lane continuing past it.

IMG_2810.jpg.title: Inside the Elena covered walkway: pebble mosaic and inserts
IMG_2810.jpg.observation: Terracotta floor with blue-and-white inserts and a round pebble mosaic, brown door, potted trees and an arched opening to a gate.

IMG_2823.jpg.title: Octagonal-paved lane with a lantana planter wall
IMG_2823.jpg.observation: Octagonal terracotta paving with covers beside a white planter wall topped with lantana, a lamp post and lawn; the sea beyond.
